| `LibraProductMetadataSourceBasis` / `LibraMediaCastSourceBasis` | Product Metadata为closed union：`metadata_observation{selection,observationSet,sourceBasisDigest=selection.selectionDigest}`或`western_analysis{westernBasis,sourceBasisDigest=westernBasis.basisDigest}`；Media Cast为closed union：`metadata_observation{selection,observationSet,sourceBasisDigest=selection.selectionDigest}`或`western_match{westernBasis,sourceBasisDigest=westernBasis.basisDigest}`。discriminator与payload必须一致，禁止空对象、双variant或隐式fallback；完整union分别受其成员上限约束 |
| `ShelfRoutingProjectionQuery` / `ShelfRoutingTargetReadResult` / `ShelfRoutingTargetProjection` | Query为`queryContract(arca.shelf-routing-projection@1),shelfIds[],queryDigest`，Shelf ID为`1..64`个、去重并按调用方Routing rank顺序，`queryDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Query excluding queryDigest))`。每项Projection为`shelfId,status(active|deregistering|deregistered),routingProjectionRevision,currentStandardRevision,currentStandardDigest,projectionDigest`；`projectionDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"arca.shelf-routing-target-projection@1",shelfId,status,routingProjectionRevision,currentStandardRevision,currentStandardDigest}))`；current Standard不存在时revision/digest均为NULL且Shelf不能成为resolved target。Read Result为`queryDigest,items[{shelfId,resultKind(found|not_found|unavailable),projection?,reasonCode?,itemDigest}],resultDigest`，按Query输入一一同序且不得省略；found恰含Projection且无reason，not_found只允许`shelf_not_found`，unavailable只允许`arca_projection_unavailable|projection_integrity_failure`；各digest排除自身后覆盖完整typed value |
| `ShelfStandard` / `ShelfStandardProjection` | `ShelfStandard@1`为`shelfId,standardRevision,ruleTemplateId,ruleTemplateRevision,profileRuleSets[],standardDigest`；Profile为`1..4`项，按`movie|series|jav|western_adult`UTF-8 bytes排序且唯一，每项为`contentProfile,decisionInputKinds[](Beta仅rating),baseRequirements(AcceptanceRequirementSet),decisionBranches[{conditionKind(no_rating|rating_equals),rating?,requirements(AcceptanceRequirementSet)}],profileRuleSetDigest`。未声明rating时Branches必须为空并直接使用base；声明rating时恰有一项no_rating和rating 1..5各一项，按no_rating后rating升序，分支携带完整六类Requirement而不是partial merge；`profileRuleSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Profile excluding profileRuleSetDigest))`，`standardDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Standard excluding standardDigest))`。Projection为`shelfId,status(active),routingProjectionRevision,projectionDigest,standard(ShelfStandard),projectionResultDigest`，全部pair必须与`ShelfRoutingTargetProjection@1`逐字节相等，`projectionResultDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Projection excluding projectionResultDigest))`；完整value≤`64 KiB` |
| `ShelfStandardProjectionQuery` / `ShelfStandardProjectionReadResult` | Query为`queryContract(arca.shelf-standard-projection@1),shelfId,expectedRoutingProjectionRevision,expectedStandardRevision,expectedStandardDigest,queryDigest`；Result为`queryDigest,resultKind(found|not_found|stale|unavailable),projection?,reasonCode?,resultDigest`。found恰含一份匹配全部expected pair的Projection；not_found只允许`shelf_not_found`，stale只允许`shelf_not_active|routing_projection_changed|standard_changed`，unavailable只允许`arca_projection_unavailable|projection_integrity_failure`；`resultDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Result excluding resultDigest))`，Query无副作用 |
| `RoutingMatchExpression` | `RoutingMatchExpression@1`只允许`always|predicate|all|any|not`节点；predicate为`factKind(content_profile|structure_kind|material_field|release_year|region|genre|resolved_provider_identity),operator(eq|one_of|gte|lte|exists),expectedValue`。`release_year`支持全部五种operator；scalar profile/structure/field支持`eq|one_of|exists`；region/genre的`eq`为规范集合精确相等、`one_of`为集合存在交集；resolved provider identity按完整typed value执行`eq|one_of|exists`；其他组合拒绝。树深度≤4、总节点≤64，`all/any`子节点`1..16`且按各子表达式digest的UTF-8 bytes排序，`not`恰一子节点；三值求值固定为`true|false|unknown`，缺失、重复冲突或typed value不兼容只能产生unknown，禁止任意JavaScript、Provider调用或隐式fallback；一次性选Shelf是独立`ManualShelfSelectionIntent@1`，永远不进入长期Rule AST |
| `FieldRoutingPolicySnapshot` | `routingPolicyId,revision,fieldId,mode(direct|sorting),targets[{shelfId,rank,matchExpression(RoutingMatchExpression),matchRuleDigest}],policyDigest`；target为`1..64`项、rank从1连续且唯一并按rank排序；direct恰一项且expression为always，sorting逐项使用closed AST；`matchRuleDigest=SHA-256(JCS(matchExpression))`，`policyDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Snapshot excluding policyDigest))`，必须逐项重建既有Policy/target rows |
| `ManualShelfSelectionIntent` / `RoutingAuthoritySnapshot` | Intent为`subjectId,targetShelfId,expectedDecisionHead{revision,digest},actorId,idempotencyKey,requestDigest`，`requestDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Intent excluding requestDigest))`；它只表达当前Subject一次性选Shelf，不改写Field Policy。Authority是union：policy分支为`authorityKind(policy),policy(FieldRoutingPolicySnapshot),authorityDigest`；manual分支为`authorityKind(manual_selection),manualIntent(ManualShelfSelectionIntent),authorityDigest`；`authorityDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整variant excluding authorityDigest))`。manual只评估这一座active Shelf；Command Receipt与routing Decision Basis同事务成立，Routing Decision只验证并引用该Receipt，不建立长期Policy或fallback |
| `SubjectDecisionSnapshot` | `subjectId,status(active),intakeRevision,structureKind(single|season),contentProfile(movie|series|jav|western_adult),routingAnchorIntakeDecisionId,routingProvenance{candidatePackageId,sourceFieldId,sourceFieldAccessRevision,sourceFieldContextDigest,candidateIdentityClaimDigest},currentIdentityRevision?,currentIdentityDigest?,continuitySetDigest,episodeScopeDigest,snapshotDigest`；routingProvenance恰从Subject不可变anchor指向的Accepted Intake Decision恢复；extension不得换成最新Field或合并多个Field Policy。identity revision/digest同时存在或同时NULL；`snapshotDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Snapshot excluding snapshotDigest))`，不得回读Procurement或Candidate Store补值 |
| `SubjectDecisionHeadSnapshot` | `subjectId,headState(absent|present),headRevision,headDigest,currentRoutingDecisionId,currentDecisionBasisId,currentAcceptanceSpecId,snapshotDigest`。`absent`只允许`headRevision=0`且headDigest/三个pointer全部NULL，表示Subject已成立但从未提交Decision Basis；`present`要求revision为正整数且current Basis非NULL，current Routing非NULL时Basis也必须非NULL，current Spec非NULL时Routing/Basis都必须非NULL；`headDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-decision-head@1",subjectId,headRevision,currentRoutingDecisionId,currentDecisionBasisId,currentAcceptanceSpecId}))`必须与Owner current row逐字节相等。`snapshotDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-decision-head-snapshot@1",subjectId,headState,headRevision,headDigest,currentRoutingDecisionId,currentDecisionBasisId,currentAcceptanceSpecId}))`；它是Basis提交前的immutable typed input，不随current Head后续CAS变化 |
| `RoutingDecisionFact` | tagged union：`content_profile{value}`、`structure_kind{value}`、`material_field{fieldId}`、`release_year{year(1870..3000)}`、`region{countryCodes[]}`、`genre{genreCodes[]}`、`resolved_provider_identity{provider,namespace,providerKey,identityRevision,identityDigest}`；公共字段为`factKind,sourceObjectId,sourceRevision,schemaRef,factDigest`，数组值去重并按UTF-8 bytes排序；`factDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整typed fact excluding factDigest))`。Beta Routing vocabulary只含这些variant；一次性选Shelf使用独立`ManualShelfSelectionIntent@1`，不伪装成Canonical Fact；新增条件必须升级Policy/Fact schema，不能用opaque JSON扩展 |
| `RoutingFactObservationIntent` | `RoutingFactObservationIntent@1`为closed union，公共字段`intentId,subjectId,routingAnchorIntakeDecisionId,routingAnchorDigest,contentProfile,identityClaim,requestedFactKinds[],sourceKind,intentDigest`；requested set为`release_year|region|genre|resolved_provider_identity`的非空去重UTF-8排序子集。`related_nfo`追加完整`relatedReferenceId,relatedReferenceDigest,expectedPhysicalIdentityDigest`且只接受对应Read Handle；`provider`追加`integrationId,configRevision,providerKind(tmdb),candidateDisplayTitle,yearHint?,strongProviderAnchor?`且只接受匹配Integration Handle。`intentDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding intentId,intentDigest))`，`intentId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.routing-fact-observation-intent-id@1",subjectId,sourceKind,intentDigest}))`；完整JCS≤16 KiB，不允许双variant、隐式source order或Executor fallback |
| `RoutingFactObservation` | `RoutingFactObservation@1`为`observationId,intentId,subjectId,sourceKind,sourceRef,result(observed|not_found|ambiguous),reasonCode?,facts[RoutingDecisionFact@1],candidateMatchCount,evidenceDigest,observationDigest`；observed要求facts恰好是本次可靠取得的requested subset且非空，其他结果facts为空；not_found只表示无可靠结果，ambiguous要求`candidateMatchCount>=2`，technical Integration/协议失败不得形成该Result。`observationId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.routing-fact-observation-id@1",intentId,evidenceDigest}))`，`observationDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding observationDigest))`，完整JCS≤64 KiB |
| `ProductScopeSnapshot` | `subjectId,scopeKind(single|episode_manifest),subjectIntakeRevision,episodeKeys[],scopeDigest`；single要求Subject structure=single且episodeKeys为空；episode_manifest要求season且为Subject current accepted Episode scope的`1..1024`项非空子集，去重并按episodeKey UTF-8 bytes升序；`scopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-scope@1",subjectId,scopeKind,subjectIntakeRevision,episodeKeys}))`。它只是Spec/未来Run的确定交付范围，不创建Run或锁定执行资源；更大Season按不重叠scope分批形成Spec/Run，不扩大单次事务边界 |
| `DecisionInputSet` | `decisionInputSetId,basisKind(routing|acceptance_spec),subjectSnapshot(SubjectDecisionSnapshot),expectedDecisionHead(SubjectDecisionHeadSnapshot),readiness{result(ready|unresolved),reasonCode?},routingAuthoritySnapshot?,shelfRoutingTargets[],routingDecision?,shelfStandardProjection?,productScope?,decisionFacts[],queryResults[VersionedQueryResult],queryResultSetDigest,routingInputDigest?,specInputDigest?,inputSetDigest`。两个Snapshot必须具有相同subjectId；顶层`shelfRoutingTargets/decisionFacts/queryResults`各≤128项并按正式ID/digest稳定排序；Product Scope的Episode上限独立遵守`ProductScopeSnapshot@1`的1024项合同。Readiness unresolved closed reason为`routing_policy_unavailable|subject_provenance_incomplete|required_input_missing|required_input_conflicting|required_input_unavailable|shelf_projection_unavailable|routing_not_resolved|target_shelf_not_active|shelf_standard_unavailable|profile_rule_not_found|product_scope_unavailable`。routing ready必须携带Authority及对应Target Projection：policy按rank携带全部候选和声明Facts，manual恰携带选中Shelf且不需要Policy；两者都不得携带Standard/Product Scope。unresolved只可省略其reason精确指向的输入。`routingInputDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.routing-input@1",subjectSnapshot,routingAuthoritySnapshotOrNull:routingAuthoritySnapshot??null,shelfRoutingTargets,decisionFacts,queryResults}))`。acceptance_spec ready必须携带resolved Routing Decision、匹配Target的active Standard Projection、Product Scope及Standard声明的Facts/Query；unresolved同样只可省略reason指向的输入。`specInputDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.spec-input@1",subjectSnapshot,routingDecisionOrNull:routingDecision??null,shelfStandardProjectionOrNull:shelfStandardProjection??null,productScopeOrNull:productScope??null,decisionFacts,queryResults}))`。两个branch digest在unresolved时仍以显式null形成，不得缺省字段。`queryResultSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.decision-query-result-set@1",items:[{providerDomain,queryContract,queryVersion,inputDigest,resultKind,resultRevision,resultDigest,expiresAtMs}]排序}))`；`inputSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding decisionInputSetId and inputSetDigest))`，因此完整pre-CAS Head Snapshot直接受其保护；`decisionInputSetId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.decision-input-set-id@1",basisKind,subjectId:subjectSnapshot.subjectId,inputSetDigest}))`；完整JCS≤`1 MiB` |
| `RoutingAssessmentEvidence` | `routingAssessmentId,subjectId,decisionBasisId,routingInputDigest,routingAuthorityKind(policy|manual_selection),routingPolicyId?,routingPolicyRevision?,manualSelectionDigest?,evaluatedTargets[{rank,shelfId,shelfProjectionRevision,shelfProjectionDigest,matchRuleDigest?,evaluation(true|false|unknown),inputFactSetDigest,evaluationDigest}],result(resolved|unresolved),targetShelfId?,unresolvedReasonCode?,shelfPrioritySetDigest,assessmentDigest`；policy分支的evaluatedTargets必须是rank 1连续前缀，第一项true或unknown后停止，全部false才允许`no_matching_shelf`；manual分支恰一项rank=1、无matchRule，Shelf active时true，否则unresolved。unresolved reason closed set为`higher_priority_rule_unknown|no_matching_shelf|manual_target_invalid|target_shelf_inactive`；`shelfPrioritySetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.shelf-priority-set@1",authorityKind:routingAuthorityKind,items:[{rank,shelfId,matchRuleDigestOrNull:matchRuleDigest??null,shelfProjectionRevision,shelfProjectionDigest}]}))`；`routingAssessmentId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.routing-assessment-id@1",subjectId,decisionBasisId,routingInputDigest}))`，每项/整体digest都排除自身后覆盖完整typed value |
| `RoutingDecision` | `routingDecisionId,subjectId,decisionRevision,assessmentId,decisionBasisId,routingAuthorityKind(policy|manual_selection),routingPolicyId?,routingPolicyRevision?,manualSelectionDigest?,routingInputDigest,shelfPrioritySetDigest,result(resolved|unresolved),targetShelfId?,unresolvedReasonCode?,decisionDigest`；authority variant与Assessment逐项相同；resolved恰含target且无reason，unresolved相反并沿用Assessment closed reason；`routingDecisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.routing-decision-id@1",assessmentId}))`，`decisionDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding decisionDigest))`；不包含Acceptance Spec、Run或Workspace |
| `AcceptanceRequirementSet` | 六个mandatory对象：`identity{identityKind(tmdb_movie|tmdb_series_season|jav_code|internal_identity),requiredProvider?(tmdb),requireSeasonNumber}`；`structure{structureKind(single|season),primaryModel(single_primary|episode_primary),requireOnePrimaryPerEpisode}`；`metadata{requiredFieldCodes[],requiredArtifactKinds[],requireRenderableSidecar,requireDecodableImages}`，field closed set为`tmdb_movie_id|tmdb_series_id|title|series_title|year_or_release_date|release_date|plot|genre|actor|director|season_number|episode_number|episode_title|episode_plot|jav_code|studio|internal_identity`，Artifact closed set为`nfo|poster|fanart`；`mandatoryMedia{mediaForm(any|stream_file),videoCodec(any|hevc),container(any|matroska),fileExtension(any|mkv),minimumRasterClass(none|4k),acceptedPrimaryAudioClasses[],forbidSystemUpscaleFor4k}`，Audio closed set为`eac3_atmos|truehd|truehd_atmos|dts_hd_ma|dts_x`；`space{unit(product|episode),maxSizeGiB?,maxSizeBytes?}`；`inventory{requireDomainBinding,requireChecksum,requiredMaterializedArtifactKinds[],layoutModel(single|season_episode)}`。数组去重按UTF-8 bytes排序；无空间上限时两个max字段同时NULL，有上限时`maxSizeGiB`为positive decimal且`maxSizeBytes=maxSizeGiB×1073741824`为精确整数；Requirement不能携带Capability、Provider选择、设备、Task或Flow参数 |
| `AcceptanceSpecDraft` / `AcceptanceSpec` | Draft为`DraftEnvelope + subjectId,targetShelfId,contentProfile(movie|series|jav|western_adult),structureKind(single|season),productScope(ProductScopeSnapshot),shelfRoutingProjectionRevision,shelfProjectionDigest,shelfStandardRevision,shelfStandardDigest,decisionBasisId,decisionBasisDigest,requirements(AcceptanceRequirementSet),specDigest`；`series`唯一对应season，其余Beta profile对应single，禁止把season写入contentProfile。`specDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.acceptance-spec-semantic@1",targetShelfId,contentProfile,structureKind,productScope:{scopeKind,episodeKeys},requirements}))`，因此Policy/query revision变化但产品要求相同仍保持同semantic digest；`DraftEnvelope.draftDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Draft excluding DraftEnvelope.draftDigest))`。Published Spec追加`acceptanceSpecId,specRevision,recordDigest,publishedAtMs`；`recordDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.acceptance-spec-record@1",specRevision,draft:完整Draft}))`，明确不包含`acceptanceSpecId/recordDigest/publishedAtMs`；`acceptanceSpecId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.acceptance-spec-id@1",subjectId,specRevision,decisionBasisId,recordDigest}))`，不存在自引用。完整Spec≤`64 KiB`，六类Requirement不得缺项 |
| `RoutingDecisionCommitResult` / `AcceptanceSpecPublicationResult` | Routing Result为`subjectId,routingDecisionId,decisionRevision,assessmentId,decisionBasisId,result,targetShelfId?,unresolvedReasonCode?,committedHeadRevision,decisionDigest,resultDigest`；Spec Result为`subjectId,acceptanceSpecId,specRevision,decisionBasisId,productScopeDigest,specDigest,recordDigest,committedHeadRevision,resultDigest`；各自`resultDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding resultDigest))`并可由Owner immutable rows加current Decision head重建。二者是application transaction result，不是Catalog Capability Result family |
| `DirectPersonRegistrationDecision` | `decisionId,newPersonId,canonicalName,aliases[{aliasDisplay,aliasNormalized,provenanceDigest}],providerIdentities[{provider,namespace,providerKey,provenanceDigest}],actorId,decisionDigest`；完整value≤`16 KiB`，`decisionDigest=SHA-256(JCS(Decision excluding decisionDigest))`；不含Reference、Candidate或Media-Cast字段 |
| `PeopleReferenceMaintenanceDecision` | 公共字段`decisionId,operationKind(add_image|release_image),personId,expectedPersonRevision,expectedReferenceRevision,actorId,decisionDigest`；首个add的逻辑expected revision为`0`并要求storage pointer为NULL，提交后建立revision 1；后续操作CAS真实正整数revision；`add_image`追加`referenceAssetId,referenceFaceId,artifactHandle,artifactDigest,faceEmbeddingSetHandle,modelRef,initialState(active)`且要求handle input digest一致、`detectedFaceCount=vectorCount=1`；`release_image`追加`referenceAssetId,referenceFaceId,expectedAssetState(active),expectedFaceState(active),terminalState(released),artifactDigest,embeddingDigest,modelRef`；digest排除自身后覆盖完整Decision |
| `PersonReferenceProjection` | `projectionContract,projectionRevision,personId,personRevision,currentReferenceRevision(null|positive),contributions[{ownerPersonId,ownerReferenceRevision,referenceSetDigest,inheritedReadOnly,activeAssets[{referenceAssetId,artifactHandleId,artifactDigest}],activeFaces[{referenceFaceId,referenceAssetId,embeddingHandleId,embeddingDigest,modelRef}]}],projectionDigest`；`currentReferenceRevision`只表示查询Person自己的local Reference pointer，从未形成local Reference revision时为`null`；此时无Merge contribution才有`contributions=[]`，正式merged-source贡献仍可出现；有local current revision但active集合为空时仍保留owner自己的Contribution；Contribution按`ownerPersonId`、内部数组按各自ID的UTF-8 bytes升序，禁止locale/case-fold排序；`projectionDigest=SHA-256(JCS({projectionContract,personId,personRevision,currentReferenceRevision,contributions}))`，明确排除`projectionRevision`和`projectionDigest`；`projectionRevision`使用People Store持久checkpoint，Person成立时为`1`，只有该semantic digest变化才CAS加`1`；Merge只展开，不复制或转移Reference，source contribution为只读 |
| `OnDeckPersonEvidenceProjectionItem` | `projectionItemId,shelfEntryId,inventoryRevision,relationId,relationDigest,displayName,displayNameNormalized,role,providerIdentities[],originEvidenceDigest,nfoObservationDigest,projectionRevision,projectionItemDigest`；只来自Arca当前Inventory person relation，完整value≤`16 KiB` |
| `OnDeckPersonEvidenceProjection` | `projectionContract,projectionRevision,cursorIn,cursorOut,items[],hasMore,pageDigest`；items最多100项并按`shelfEntryId,inventoryRevision,relationId`稳定排序；是跨Domain只读Projection，不是Business Handoff或People Fact |
| `PerceptionResolutionQuery` | `queryContract,queryVersion,querySchemaRef,factKind(rating|watched),identityEvidence[{anchorKind,anchorValue,confidenceClass,evidenceDigest}],queryInputDigest`；Identity Evidence最多16项，完整value≤`16 KiB`，`queryInputDigest=SHA-256(JCS(Query excluding queryInputDigest))`并与CanonicalQueryHandle typedInput一致；`@1`只支持这两个kind，新增kind必须升级schema/contract version |
| `PerceptionResolutionRecordSet` | `queryInputDigest,records[{perceptionId,recordKind,sourceKind,sourceRecordKey,sourceRecordRevision,recordDigest,facts{rating?,watchedState?},observedTitle,observedAtMs,identityAnchors[{anchorKind,anchorValue,confidenceClass,evidenceDigest}],provenanceRef,provenanceDigest}],relations[{relationId,relationKind(duplicate_of|supersedes|retracts),sourcePerceptionId,targetPerceptionId,ruleRevision,evidenceDigest}],recordSetDigest`；每个Record最多16个Anchor，records最多256项、relations最多1024项、完整canonical value≤`512 KiB`；所有Record/Relation必须可由Perception immutable facts精确验证；候选数不得超过Rule Snapshot的`maxCandidateRecords`，`recordSetDigest`排除自身后覆盖完整canonical value |
| `PerceptionResolutionRuleSnapshot` | `ruleContract,ruleVersion,supportedFactKinds,candidateRetrievalClauses[{anchorKind,lookupMode(exact|normalized_exact|bounded_fuzzy),normalizationProfileRef?,threshold?,maxCandidates}],anchorMatchers[{anchorKind,matchMode(exact|normalized_exact|fuzzy),normalizationProfileRef?,strengthRank,minConfidenceClass,threshold?}],winnerOrder(strongest_anchor_then_value_consensus_then_perception_id),equalStrengthConflict(not_found),duplicateProofMatchers[{anchorKind,matchMode(exact),minConfidenceClass,requireSameAnchorValue(true),requireSameFactKind(true),requireSameCanonicalValue(true)}],maxCandidateRecords,ruleDigest`；三个规则数组分别最多32项且完整Snapshot≤`64 KiB`；fuzzy clause/matcher必须提供threshold，非fuzzy不得携带threshold；strengthRank在一个Rule内唯一且正整数；Beta `maxCandidateRecords=256`；完整可执行声明式规则随Binary/Catalog版本化，禁止任意JavaScript、函数或Store query，`ruleDigest`排除自身后覆盖完整canonical value |
| `PeopleCandidatePolicyRef` | `policyKind(registration|merge), policyRevision, ruleSchemaRef, ruleDigest`；Beta引用随Binary/Catalog发布的immutable system decision contract，不要求另建可变Policy head；只供People Candidate Resolver使用，不是用户可确认对象 |
| `PeopleCandidateAcceptanceDecision` | 公共字段`decisionId,candidateKind,candidateId,expectedCandidateRevision,candidatePayloadDigest,decisionOrigin(user|strong_identity_rule),actorId?,ruleRevision?,decisionDigest`；Registration分支必须追加`newPersonId`；Merge分支必须追加`sourcePersonId,targetPersonId,expectedSourcePersonRevision,expectedTargetPersonRevision,expectedSourcePreferenceRevision(null|positive),expectedTargetPreferenceRevision(null|positive),preferenceResolution(keep_source|keep_target|set_explicit),explicitPreferenceLevel?`；target必须是规范化pair成员，`set_explicit`时level必为`-2..2`；`user`要求actorId，`strong_identity_rule`要求ruleRevision且遇Preference冲突不得签发；`decisionDigest=SHA-256(JCS(Decision excluding decisionDigest))` |

Handoff A `IntakeStructuredRejection@1`只允许以下closed reason code，并按此precedence排序：

1. `candidate_contract_invalid`：完整Delivery Snapshot可重建，但Candidate/Manifest/Offer字段、digest或成员闭包验证失败；
2. `candidate_material_identity_changed`：Primary Material当前Identity/Fence与Delivery冻结值不一致；
3. `candidate_material_unavailable`：正式Read Handle无法取得对应Primary Material；
4. `candidate_material_unreadable`：Material存在但有界读取/探测无法完成Intake验证；
5. `candidate_control_scope_unavailable`：精确Candidate member的current Control已不满足从Procurement转给Libra的前置条件。

每个reason必须引用对应`CandidateContractVerification@1`、`IntakeMaterialVerification@1`或
`MaterialControlProjectionSnapshot@1`的正式Evidence ID/digest。数组只包含真实发生的code，按precedence去重；第一项
就是`primaryRejectionCode`。上述reason是Handoff合同、Material reality或Control前置条件失败；Subject continuity的
none/multiple/Episode overlap不是rejection reason，仍按`SubjectContinuityResolutionDecision@1`建立new Subject。

Beta Triage Rule的可执行语义固定如下；这些规则属于`ProcurementTriageRuleSnapshot.rulePayload`，不是Executor
default，也不能由Planner、Field配置或文件名library另设一套：

1. **Playability**：每个Batch Result逐项绑定`materialKey + bindingRevision + MediaProbeEvidence.payloadDigest`。
   `resultKind=probed`且`videoStreams.length>=1`且`durationMs>=1`时`playable=true,reasonCodes=[]`；否则
   `playable=false`并只使用`probe_not_media → no_video_stream → non_positive_duration`的closed precedence。
   Handle/Fence、Probe contract或digest不匹配是Capability contract/fence failure，不伪装成`playable=false`。
2. **Series token grammar**：ASCII token大小写不敏感，token边界只允许字符串首尾或`space . _ -`。
   Episode只识别`S<1..2 digits>E<1..3 digits>`、`<1..2 digits>x<1..3 digits>`和`第<1..3 digits>集`；
   前两种允许`E<end>`或`-<end>`的闭区间且`end>=start`、最多展开32集。Season只识别同一S/x token、
   `Season <1..2 digits>`、`S<1..2 digits>`或`第<1..2 digits>季`。同一Unit出现不同显式Season即
   `conflicting_season_claim`；没有显式Season时，只有Field Hint为`series`或mixed规则已命中Episode token才可用
   `provisionalGroupKey=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"procurement.provisional-season-group@1",fieldId,parentSegments}))`，
   不得默认Season 1。无法取得Episode Claim为`episode_claim_unresolved`。
3. **Profile与Unit**：显式Hint按Rule mapping直接决定Profile/mediaType；`mixed`先检测Series Episode token，再
   检测JAV code grammar`2..10个ASCII letter + 可选[-_ ] + 2..6 digits`，其余可播放普通文件形成Movie
   fallback。Western Adult不从mixed猜测。single普通文件每个可播放Material形成一个Unit；Series按相同
   explicit/provisional Season claim与稳定父目录grouping形成Unit；BDMV只有同时观察到`BDMV/index.bdmv`、
   `BDMV/MovieObject.bdmv`、至少一个`PLAYLIST/*.mpls`和`STREAM/*.m2ts`且Probe形成可审计主标题选择才形成
   Movie Unit；DVD要求`VIDEO_TS/VIDEO_TS.IFO`、至少一个匹配VTS IFO/VOB；ISO要求Probe明确`discTopology=single_title`。
   多标题本身不再阻塞；真实歧义、结构缺失或不同Unit成员重叠仍not_ready。
4. **Related association**：只从Shared Layout Evidence中选择有完整Physical Identity、SHA-256、Endpoint与
   location的file entry；与Primary同stem，或basename恰为`movie.nfo|tvshow.nfo|poster.*|fanart.*`的标准
   Sidecar可形成Reference。扩展名只映射到`nfo|poster|fanart|subtitle|external_audio|chapter|sidecar`closed role；
   多个候选可以分别作为只读Reference，不推断winner，缺失或歧义不阻止Candidate。BDMV根目录内的Playlist、
   Clipinfo、Stream、index和MovieObject只属于该BDMV Unit的结构成员，禁止进入Related Reference；普通电影的
   sidecar只可来自已观察的外部电影目录Layout Evidence。
5. **Structure Result**：`resolved` page中的Unit按`unitId` UTF-8 bytes排序，`unassignedMaterials[]`按materialKey
   排序并只使用`probe_not_media|no_video_stream|non_positive_duration|content_profile_unresolved|
   conflicting_season_claim|episode_claim_unresolved|disc_structure_incomplete|disc_non_primary_title|
   disc_multi_title_unsupported|triage_unit_contract_too_large|structure_ambiguous`；Movie多Playlist本身不再进入
   `disc_multi_title_unsupported`，只有无法按确定性规则选出主标题时才稳定not_ready；同一Material必须且只能出现在所有page的一个Unit或一项
   unassigned结果中。整轮至少一个Unit时每页`resultKind=resolved`，整轮没有Unit时唯一terminal page固定
   `resultKind=not_ready,units=[]`；page完整JCS bytes≤`64 KiB`，超出时在Unit边界分页，禁止截断Unit。
6. **Identity**：Claim kind按Profile固定映射；`claimedTitle/displayIdentity`按`directory_title → filename_title →
   temporary_label(materialKey前12位)`取首个非空Evidence，JAV优先使用规范化番号作为displayIdentity；
   `mediaType/contentProfile/seasonClaim/sourceHints`逐字段复制Unit中的typed值。该规则只形成Identity Claim，
   不解析或宣称TMDB/Canonical identity。

`TriageStructureInspectionInput`可很大，但Plan只持久化typed binding refs，不把完整DTO塞入`input_bindings_json`；
Runtime按精确Result binding装配后调用pure Executor。所有单项Result/Evidence仍遵守`64 KiB`上限；一个Unit本身
超过该上限即按closed reason不ready，而不是创建Artifact、隐藏Store或提高Foundation JSON上限。

Procurement Run Seal的digest basis固定如下，所有`items`均按`materialKey`的UTF-8 bytes升序且key唯一；空集合也按
相同schema对`items=[]`计算，不使用NULL、时间戳或数据库行顺序代替：

~~~text
candidateReservationSetDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.candidate-reservation-set@1",
  items: [{materialKey, candidatePackageId, packageDigest}]
}))

releasedMaterialSetDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.run-released-material-set@1",
  items: [{materialKey, disposition, evidenceDigest}]
}))

sealEvidenceDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.run-seal-evidence@1",
  procurementRunId,
  sealedStateRevision,
  runBasisDigest,
  sealDecisionDigest,
  sealOutcome,
  candidateReservationCount,
  candidateReservationSetDigest,
  releasedMaterialCount,
  releasedMaterialSetDigest
}))
~~~

公式中的`sealDecisionDigest`固定等于`ProcurementRunSealDecision.decisionDigest`。
`candidateReservationCount`是展开全部published Candidate Manifest后的Material数，不是Candidate数；每个展开项
必须与`proc_run_materials.candidate_package_id`精确相等，Seal时其guard可以仍为`candidate_delivery`，也可以已因
Handoff A终态变为`transferred|released`；digest表达本Run发布过的Candidate member set，不伪称终态后仍有active
Reservation。`releasedMaterialCount`是Seal本次从
`run_selection`释放的成员数；每项`evidenceDigest`必须同时等于Decision member和
`proc_run_materials.terminal_evidence_digest`。两组count、digest和Run head的`seal_evidence_digest`在同一Seal
事务写入；后续Handoff状态变化不修改本次Seal digest。

Procurement Retry的digest与重放basis固定如下。`failedRunMaterialDigest`只从failed Run的durable head/member row
重建；`retryAdmissionHeadDigest`固定等于`ProcurementRetryIntent.retryAdmissionHead.headDigest`；Retry Creator不得
从最新Field Material或调用者payload补值：

~~~text
failedRunMaterialDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.failed-run-material@1",
  failedRunId,
  failedRunBasisDigest,
  ordinal,
  materialKey,
  basisMemberDigest,
  terminalDisposition: "triage_failed",
  terminalEvidenceDigest
}))

memberPreconditionDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.retry-member-precondition@1",
  ordinal,
  materialKey,
  failedRunMaterialDigest,
  expectedBindingRevision,
  expectedEligibilityRevision,
  expectedEligibilityBasisDigest,
  expectedSelectionBasisDigest,
  expectedSelectionHasConflict: false,
  expectedControlSnapshot
}))

retryScopeDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.retry-scope@1",
  failedRunId,
  failedRunBasisDigest,
  items: [{ordinal, materialKey, failedRunMaterialDigest}]
}))

preconditionSetDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.retry-precondition-set@1",
  retryAdmissionHeadDigest,
  items: [{ordinal, materialKey, memberPreconditionDigest}]
}))

staleMaterialSetDigest = SHA-256(JCS({
  schema: "procurement.retry-stale-material-set@1",
  items: [{ordinal, materialKey, consumeSnapshotDigest, staleReasonCode}]
}))
~~~

`retryScopeDigest`与`preconditionSetDigest`中的完整member数组按`materialKey` UTF-8 bytes升序并使用连续
`ordinal`；`staleMaterialSetDigest`只保留stale子集及其原始ordinal。三者都必须与Intent relation rows精确对应。
`ProcurementRetryConsumeMemberSnapshot.snapshotDigest`就是公式中的`consumeSnapshotDigest`。Intent terminal时，
实际`ProcurementRetryAdmissionHead`、全部member consume snapshot、Intent state/new Run link、typed Result和marker
同事务成立；current row之后再次变化不影响这份immutable consume Evidence。

Retry stale primary reason采用以下closed set与固定precedence；每个stale member只保存第一个成立的code：

1. `field_status_changed`；
2. `field_profile_hint_changed`；
3. `field_access_changed`；
4. `terminal_observation_changed`；
5. `extraction_policy_changed`；
6. `triage_rule_changed`；
7. `material_not_present`；
8. `material_binding_changed`；
9. `material_not_eligible`；
10. `material_eligibility_changed`；
11. `material_guard_conflict`；
12. `material_control_unavailable`；
13. `material_control_not_acquirable`；
14. `material_control_changed`。

前六项比较Intent与consume的`ProcurementRetryAdmissionHead`精确字段；Profile比较完整
`MaterialFieldProfileHintSnapshot@1`，其中Triage比较
`ruleRef/revision/ruleSchemaRef/ruleDigest/authorityDigest`并要求consume时仍是Registry active entry。其余项依次比较
material存在性、Binding revision、Eligibility state、Eligibility revision/basis、Selection conflict、Control Query
可用性、是否为`uncontrolled`或同一`material_field/fieldId`可assert、最后比较完整Control `projectionDigest`。
任一member stale则整个Intent进入`stale`且不建Run；head stale作用于全部member。`staleReasonCodes[]`只收集各
stale member的primary code，按上述precedence去重排序；`primary_stale_reason_code=staleReasonCodes[0]`。created
结果要求全部member为matched；stale结果的count/digest/reasons必须可由consume rows唯一重建。

`ProcurementRunSealReceipt`、`ProcurementRetryIntentReceipt`与`ProcurementRetryAdmissionResult`是Procurement
Application Transaction的typed command/result DTO，不是新增Catalog Capability output family；它们必须生成正式
JSON Schema并参与transaction/replay fixture；该Procurement闭合本身不改变当时96个Catalog Result family计数。
`PBF-22`的`MaterialFieldRegistrationCommand`、`MaterialFieldProfileHintSnapshot`、
`MaterialFieldProfileHintRevisionCommand`、`MaterialFieldAdminProjection`与
`ProcurementMaterialFieldAdminResult`同样必须进入正式application contract registry；
`FieldObservationPageRequest`、`FieldObservationPage`、`ObservationCommitResult`、
`MaterialFieldContext`、`ProcurementRunExecutionBasis`、`ProcurementRetryAdmissionHead`及相关Plan binding
schema必须原位传播完整Snapshot `$ref`。Materializer对任一missing/unresolved ref、仍只接受裸
`contentProfileHint`的旧shape、nullable/opaque Snapshot或dual schema path必须fail closed；不因此新增Catalog
Capability或Result family。
`ProcurementTriageRuleSnapshot/Registry`、`ProcurementRetryAdmissionHead`与
`ProcurementRetryConsumeMemberSnapshot`同样是既有Procurement Application/Planner的formal contract或Evidence，
不新增Capability、Process Root、Business Object、Store或Result family。
`TriageMaterialProbeBatch`、`MaterialFieldContext`、三个Triage input DTO、`TriageUnitSnapshot`与`CandidateDraft`
都是既有Procurement Run/Plan的formal typed input；`PrimaryInputManifestDraft`替换原来错误地由pure Builder直接
输出published Manifest的同一Catalog Result slot，最终`PrimaryInputManifest`成为Candidate Publication事务内
建立的accepted Deliverable。该Triage修正本身保持112项Capability与当时96个Catalog Result family不变。

`PBF-11-R2-R1`把Handoff A富拒绝输出正式收窄为`IntakeRejectionReceipt@1`，Handoff B继续使用可由Arca
Owner rows重建的`RejectionReceipt@1`；因此当前Catalog仍为112项Capability，但unique Result family由96增加为97。
`PBF-11-R2-R2`只闭合Procurement Handoff A terminal consumption的row lifecycle：
`proc_candidate_deliveries`仅允许一次`open → accepted|rejected`CAS，`proc_run_materials`仅允许已列出的Reservation
transition；Accepted/Rejected application transaction result都从terminal Owner rows重建，不新增Catalog Result family。
`PBF-11-R3`只闭合Handoff A Accepted Receipt的Control revision set：唯一JCS formula绑定Payload、Commit Handle、
expected/committed revision与两端scope；historical Control revision可以在current owner后来变化后重建相同Receipt，
不新增Catalog Result family或持久表。
`PBF-12`只把Level 5已经Accepted的Routing/Decision Preparation/Acceptance Spec语义物化为formal DTO、三项
Canonical Transaction与既有Owner row连续性，并把Canonical `contentProfile=series`传播到Spec Schema；新增的
Routing/Spec application results不是Catalog Capability output，故Capability仍为112、Catalog Result family仍为97，
关系表仍为169。Canonical Transaction由35项增至38项。
`PBF-12-R1`只补齐Decision Basis的历史pre-CAS Head input连续性：新增formal
`SubjectDecisionHeadSnapshot@1`，把它作为每份Basis恰一条既有Libra input relation保存，并在Basis row/Result冻结
revision与snapshot digest。它不新增表、Capability、Result family、Canonical Transaction、Owner、Store或Handoff；
实现DDL把logical expected revision 0映射为non-negative列约束属于同一合同的机器传播。
`PBF-13`只把Level 3/6已经Accepted的Libra Run、Workspace、Product Package、Discard与Reclamation责任链补成
Owner-row可恢复合同：新增Run admission/state history、Production Material N:M Episode快照、Workspace revision及
Package Material Episode/Fact/Artifact membership七张Libra关系表，五项Application transaction与完整typed DTO；不新增Domain、
Owner、Store、Business Object、Handoff或Catalog Capability。关系表由169增至176，Canonical Transaction由38增至43，
Catalog仍为112项Capability/97个Result family。
`PBF-13-R2`只修正同一Run Admission/Promotion链的机器连续性：initial expected admission head在历史Run revision
中合法保存logical 0，实际admission head及committed head仍从1开始；`package_revision_head`固定为non-negative
SQLite INTEGER、Run建立时为0并由Promotion执行数值CAS+1；每个Material的`outputRequirementDigest`固定从同一
immutable Acceptance Spec、manifest/material role与Episode application scope派生，不接受caller opaque值。它不新增
表、事务、Owner、Capability或业务状态；新增的typed requirement binding只是既有Manifest字段的正式来源合同。
`PBF-13-R3`只闭合Run Input Physical Identity/size的跨Handoff连续性：Procurement Run Admission从同事务current
Field Material冻结完整`PhysicalMaterialIdentity@2 + sizeBytes`到Selected Set与immutable Run member；Candidate
Publication把同一值复制到final Manifest及Candidate Primary relation；`CandidateDeliverySnapshot@1`从两组immutable
Owner rows交叉验证后输出；Handoff A通过`LibraBindingDraft@1`逐项写入Libra Binding；Libra Run Admission只从该
immutable Binding revision建立Production Material Manifest。任一层缺失或不一致均为integrity failure，禁止用
materialKey反解、current Field、Provider、Foundation Result或caller cache修补。该修正只扩充既有typed DTO与三张
既有关系表的列，不新增表、事务、Owner、Store、Handoff、Capability或Result family，计数保持不变。
`PBF-13-R4`只闭合既有Run Lifecycle的freshness与bounded recovery：固定可由Owner rows重建的原始/current Basis
Snapshot、随binary版本化恢复Policy、五次有界assessment、typed Priority/terminal/complete Evidence与唯一digest映射；
每次suspend/reassess/resume/freeze都在既有Run aggregate与append-only revision中CAS并冻结完整Evidence，重启按持久化
due/attempt继续，frozen永不自动恢复。它不新增业务状态、组件、表、事务、Capability或Result family。
`PBF-13-R4-R1`只把上述Lifecycle强制验证输入传播到Canonical Transaction的精确machine read set：Comparable
Basis、published Package custody fence与terminal Work Evidence均在同一SQLite事务内由Owner rows重建并交叉验证，
禁止事务外Assessment造成TOCTOU；write set及全部架构计数不变。
`PBF-13-R4-R2`只把`ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1`的ID/dedup JCS basis从含糊取值路径改成显式顶层
`receiptDigest` property；Message字段、Handoff、事务与全部计数不变。
`PBF-13-R5`只把既有Platform Workspace配置与Libra Workspace Admission接成正式typed边界：Platform Port返回不含
resolved path的Root Snapshot，并用Platform内部路径形成30秒有效的space admission Evidence；Libra只冻结Snapshot与
Evidence并由既有Workspace Admission transaction验证current root fence。它不新增Domain、Handoff、Capability、表或事务。
`PBF-13-R5-R1`只修正Workspace aggregate/current revision首次建立的SQLite循环FK：current-head复合FK延迟到
transaction commit验证，child→aggregate父FK保持immediate并固定aggregate-first插入；没有nullable、sentinel或计数变化。
`PBF-13-R5-R2`只把immutable Run Manifest/member传播进Workspace Admission exact read set，使空间需求在同一事务
重算并验证；Episode Claim明确排除，write set与全部计数不变。
`PBF-13-R5-R3`闭合Workspace Material Handle与Product Verification连续性：Foundation既有material row冻结完整
Handle，Libra既有Reference row冻结完整typed Verification，Decision ID使用显式JCS keys；不新增表、能力或事务。

Libra Intake的current set digest固定为：

- `subjectContinuitySetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-continuity-set@1",subjectId,items}))`，
  `items`是该Subject全部continuity relation的
  `{claimKind,claimNamespace,claimKey,claimDigest,provenanceKind,provenanceRef}`，按这六项UTF-8 bytes升序；
- `subjectEpisodeScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-episode-scope@1",subjectId,
  episodeKeys}))`，Episode key去重并按UTF-8 bytes升序；single固定空集合；
- Handoff A new/extension、Resolved Identity exact Claim追加以及Subject terminal都会在同一事务重算受影响Subject
  digest并CAS `active_subject_continuity` global head。global head用于防0/1/N query phantom，Subject
  `intake_revision`与两个set digest用于防唯一target内容变化，二者不能互相代替；
- Intake exact match只查询`active` Subject的`libra_subject_season_continuity_claims`；Product Identity中的exact
  provider-season anchor必须先由其Owner commit关系化到该表。`libra_product_identity_revisions`的set digest、
  display title或Provider Result都不是Intake的可执行匹配输入。

`libra_intake_decisions.decision_digest`按`decision_kind`唯一映射：`accepted_resolution`逐字节等于正式
`SubjectContinuityResolutionDecision@1.decisionDigest`，`rejected_acceptance`逐字节等于正式
`IntakeRejectionDecision@1.decisionDigest`。Accepted的match witness与overlap relation必须能按同一排序和公式重建
continuity Decision中的两个aggregate digest；Rejected的`libra_intake_rejection_reason_evidence`必须能按closed
precedence重建完整Reason/Evidence数组及`rejectionReasonSetDigest/rejectionDigest`。`libra_handoff_a_receipts`也按
outcome唯一映射：accepted重建`SubjectAndTransferReceipt@1`并以`accepted_payload_digest`作为scopeDigest，rejected
重建`IntakeRejectionReceipt@1`并以`IntakeRejectionDecision.decisionDigest`作为scopeDigest。Accepted Receipt中的Subject
continuity/Episode digest使用Receipt冻结值，禁止旁读后来扩充的Subject current row；其Control set使用同一commit
marker的transfer revisions及每项previous revision重建expected/committed projection与唯一digest，禁止读取后来
current Control owner或把Receipt中的摘要当成不可验证真值；Rejected Receipt不允许补写
Subject、Continuity head、Binding或Control字段。任何row能写入但对应typed Decision/Receipt无法重建，typed payload
存在而relation row缺失，或两种variant列同时出现，均为Canonical Transaction integrity failure，不能用最新状态、
Foundation Event Result或另一Domain Store补齐。

Rejected variant固定`libra_intake_decisions.rejection_schema_ref=IntakeStructuredRejection@1`，且
`decided_at_ms=structuredRejection.decidedAtMs`；Reason ordinal从0连续，Evidence ordinal在各Reason内从0连续。
Accepted variant的`rejection_schema_ref`及全部rejection列必须为NULL。SQLite必须以variant `CHECK`和deferred FK
表达这些条件，不能只依赖Application约定。

通用结果envelope固定为：

- `EvidenceEnvelope`：`evidenceId, evidenceKind, producerRef, basisDigest, payloadDigest, observedAtMs`；
- `VerificationEnvelope`：`verificationId, verificationKind, basisDigest, result
  (passed|failed|not_applicable), reasonCodes[], evidenceRefs[], verifiedAtMs`；
- `DomainFactEnvelope`：`factId, ownerDomain, aggregateType, aggregateId, revision, factSchemaRef, factDigest,
  commitMarker, committedAtMs`；
- `ReceiptEnvelope`：`receiptId, receiptKind, ownerDomain, scopeType, scopeId, scopeDigest, effectReceiptRef?,
  committedAtMs`；
- `ManifestEnvelope`：`manifestId, manifestKind, schemaVersion, ownerDomain, memberCount, membersDigest,
  manifestDigest, publishedAtMs`；
- `DraftEnvelope`：`draftId, draftKind, basisDigest, schemaRef, draftDigest, producedAtMs`，只允许在当前Plan内使用。

#### 8.6.19 Domain nominal type registry

`FieldObservationPage`、`ObservationCommitResult`和`LayoutEvidence`的旧registry行仅保留作历史语义追溯，
不属于active Catalog；active Observation合同是`ObservationPageCommitResult@1`与紧凑
`ObservationPageCommitReceipt@1`，Layout是Observation entry Projection，不是Capability或Result。

下表给出Catalog所有Result type的mandatory domain payload。每一项同时继承上一节对应envelope；没有列出的
字段可以在`@1`的JSON Schema中作为optional且必须有明确含义，但不得参与热筛选而不关系化。

| Result type group | Mandatory domain payload |
| --- | --- |
| `ObservationPageCommitReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + observationId + fieldObservationWorkId + fieldId + committedObservationRevision + pageOrdinal + entryCount + pageDigest + entrySetDigest + nextCursor + hasMore + receiptDigest`；只证明Observation entry rows已在同一事务成立，不内联文件明细；完整value≤`16 KiB` |
| `FilesystemIdentityEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + identity + endpointId + location + statSizeBytes + statMtimeMs` |

| `WorkspaceCleanupCommitReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + cleanupScopeId + scopeStateRevision + materialHandleId + memberStateRevision + outcomeEvidenceDigest + releasedControlRevision? + releasedControlProjectionDigest? + cleanupState(completed|blocked) + receiptDigest`；固定`receiptKind=libra_workspace_cleanup_member,ownerDomain=libra,scopeType=workspace_cleanup_member,scopeId=cleanupScopeId+":"+materialHandleId,scopeDigest=WorkspaceCleanupCommitDecision.decisionDigest`，`receiptId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-receipt-id@1",cleanupScopeId,materialHandleId,memberStateRevision}))`；completed的outcome是Deletion Evidence，blocked的outcome是Blocking Evidence；Control双字段同为NULL或同为非NULL且blocked恒为NULL；`receiptDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding receiptDigest))` |
| `AcquisitionQuery` | 8.6.8 `PBF-16` exact Query：完整Run/Basis、Resolved Identity Anchor、Product Structure/Episode scope、terms/constraints及唯一query digest；不含Workspace path |
| `AcquisitionCandidates` | `EvidenceEnvelope + queryDigest + integrationId + configRevision + candidates[0..100 ProviderAcquisitionCandidateSnapshot] + candidateSetDigest`；完整typed集合、排序、digest与64 KiB双界见8.6.8 |
| `SelectedCandidate` | 8.6.8 closed `selected|not_selected` Draft；selected内联完整selected Provider Candidate Snapshot，not_selected不伪造ID；两者均绑定Query/Criteria/Candidate set |
| `AcquisitionObservation` | ready-only `EvidenceEnvelope + ExternalJobReceipt完整值 + phase + providerObservationRevision + outputSnapshot + observationDigest`；pending使用`deferred`且不发布Result，禁止free-form state/outputRefs |
| `StableExternalMaterialEvidence` | `VerificationEnvelope + sourceExternalMaterialHandleId + stableExternalMaterialHandle完整值 + observationWindow + stableDigest`；只由一次P5 bounded observation形成，最终Handle允许相对初次Resolve签发新revision/manifest |
| `IdentityVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + expectedIdentityDigest + observedIdentityDigest + strengthClass(exact_provider_identity|unverified)`；closed result/reason与Anchor tuple算法见8.6.8 |
| `VerifiedExternalPackage` | `VerificationEnvelope + stableExternalMaterialHandleId + stableManifestDigest + episodeDeliveryManifestDigest + identityVerificationId + identityVerificationDigest + verifiedMemberIds[] + verifiedMemberSetDigest + packageManifestDigest`；只接受同一Stable Evidence和passed Identity Verification |
| `AcceptanceCheck` | `VerificationEnvelope + acceptanceAttemptId + checkKind + standardRevision + packageDigest` |
| `InventoryFeasibilityEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + shelfId + placementRevision + targetEndpointId + requiredBytes + availableBytes + finalInventoryDecisionDraftDigest` |
| `ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims` | `items[0..32]{episodeKey,seasonClaimDigest,claimDigest},episodeClaimSetDigest`；正式`schemaRef=helix://contracts/application-types/ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims/v1`，items按`episodeKey` UTF-8 bytes升序且key唯一；单项`claimDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-material-episode-claim@1",episodeKey,seasonClaimDigest}))`，`episodeClaimSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-material-episode-claims@1",items}))`，因此逐字节等于来源`ProductionMaterialManifest@1` member的同名Set digest而不是Arca另造摘要；Series Product Primary要求`1..32`项，single Primary与全部非Primary/Off-load Context-only member固定为空Set；完整value≤`16 KiB` |
| `CustodyAndTransferReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + acceptanceDecisionId + custodyId + arcaBindingSetDigest + controlRevisionSetDigest + relatedDispositionSetDigest + receiptDigest`；`arcaBindingSetDigest`覆盖每个Binding的完整`ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims@1`与authority variant而不只覆盖Set digest；`relatedDispositionSetDigest`逐字节等于Package/Custody冻结值且不冒充Control；`receiptDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding receiptDigest))`，完整value≤`16 KiB` |
| `StagedInventoryManifest` | `ManifestEnvelope + targetCommitSlotId + stagedMembers[{sourceMaterialKey,sourceRelatedReferenceId?,materialKey,role,dispositionKind?,endpointId,location,bindingRevision,digestHex,sizeBytes,episodeClaims(ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims)}] + sourceProductManifestDigest + relatedDispositionSetDigest`；`sourceMaterialKey`逐字节命中来源Product member；当成员承担exclusive Related义务时`sourceRelatedReferenceId`与`dispositionKind(carried_forward|replaced_and_settled)`必须命中Off-load Context；`materialKey`是Stage后目标Physical Material。member按`sourceMaterialKey,materialKey` UTF-8 bytes排序且两个key各自唯一，每项Episode Set逐字节等于来源Product member；Manifest digest覆盖完整members及Related disposition set，不允许Stage后补Claim或遗漏既有exclusive Related |
| `StagedInventoryVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + stagedInventoryManifestDigest + finalInventoryDecisionDigest`；passed要求每个Staged member按`sourceMaterialKey`唯一命中Final Inventory Decision所引用Product member，且完整`ArcaMaterialEpisodeClaims@1`逐字节相等 |
| `PlacementSwitchReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + targetCommitSlotId + finalBindingSetDigest + replacedInputSetDigest + transactionRevision` |
| `FinalProductVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + finalBindingSetDigest + productManifestDigest + relatedDispositionSetDigest + verifiedMaterialKeys[] + targetContainmentDigest`；逐项覆盖最终Primary及物化Related/Artifact，证明全部当前承载位于Shelf Target |
| `SettlementDeletionEvidence` / `DeletionEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + authorizationOrApprovalRef + materialKey + dispositionMemberRef + sourceToFinalMappingDigest + finalProductVerificationDigest + preDeleteIdentityDigest + postDeleteReality + effectReceiptId`；Input Settlement variant必须逐项命中同Run Approval和已验证successor；direct-carried同一Physical Identity不得伪造Deletion Evidence |
| `FulfillmentVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + finalInventoryDecisionDigest + shelfStandardRevision + finalRealityDigest + relatedDispositionCompletionDigest + unresolvedDispositionCount(0)`；passed要求全部Candidate Material Disposition成员均终态且不存在指向Material Field中exclusive Related的active Inventory reference |
| `OnDeckCommitResult` | `onDeckCommitReceipt + offloadCompletionFact`；两者在同一Responsibility Control transaction产生，不能单独成功 |
| `OnDeckCommitReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + shelfEntryId + inventoryRevision + deckFactRevision + controlRevisionSetDigest + relatedDispositionCompletionDigest` |
| `OffloadCompletionFact` | `DomainFactEnvelope + onDeckRunId + shelfEntryId + inventoryRevision + packageId + completionDigest` |
| `CustodyAssessmentEvidence` / `PresentationAssessmentEvidence` / `ConformanceAssessmentEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + shelfEntryId + inventoryRevision + standardRevision + placementRevision + decisionFactSetDigest + careBasisDigest + assessmentState + findingDrafts[]` |
| `AssessmentRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + shelfEntryId + careBasisDigest + professionalAssessmentSetDigest` |
| `MaterialEffectReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + targetBindingDigest + materialEffectKind + effectReceiptId + finalRealityDigest` |
| `CareProductVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + aftercareCaseId + careRequirementDigest + workspaceMediaHandleId` |
| `AftercareInventoryCommitReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + aftercareCaseId + shelfEntryId + previousInventoryRevision + newInventoryRevision + controlChangeDigest` |
| `AftercareCaseResult` | `DomainFactEnvelope + aftercareCaseId + resultState + reassessmentDigest + inventoryEffectRefs[]` |
| `DuplicateGroupEvidenceList` | `EvidenceEnvelope + groups[{groupId,canonicalIdentityDigest,shelfEntryIds[]}]`；不建议保留/删除哪一个 |
| `DuplicateGroupRevisionList` | `DomainFactEnvelope + duplicateGroupIds[] + memberSetDigests[] + supersededGroupIds[]` |
| `ReviewCandidateRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + candidateId + shelfEntryId + policyRevision + reasonDigest + state` |
| `ScopeVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + destructionScopeId + inventoryRevision + controlRevisionSetDigest + materialKeys[]` |
| `ReferenceReleaseResult` | `DomainFactEnvelope + shelfEntryId + referenceId + remainingReferenceCount + released` |
| `DestructionCompletionVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + destructionScopeId + authorizationId + deletionEvidenceSetDigest` |
| `OffdeckTerminalReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + offdeckCaseId + shelfEntryId + terminalDeckFactRevision + releasedControlSetDigest` |
| `ReleaseVerification` | `VerificationEnvelope + deregistrationId + shelfId + releaseManifestDigest + controlRevisionSetDigest` |
| `DeregistrationReceipt` | `ReceiptEnvelope + deregistrationId + shelfId + releasedControlSetDigest + terminalFactDigest` |
| `PerceptionObservationPage` | `EvidenceEnvelope + perceptionAcquisitionId + pageOrdinal + source{sourceId,sourceKind,sourceConfigRevision} + cursor{expectedCursorRevision,cursorIn,cursorOut} + observations[{observationId,sourceRecordKey,sourceRecordRevision,sourceRecordDigest,observedAtMs,payloadSchemaRef,payloadDigest,inlinePayload,provenanceDigest}] + observationPageDigest + hasMore`；每项Observation必须包含Normalize所需的bounded typed `inlinePayload`且canonical bytes匹配`payloadDigest`；单项≤`16 KiB`、整页Result≤`64 KiB`。完整Provider response不进入Result；Adapter以字段投影/page budget满足限制，超限稳定失败且不推进cursor，禁止pure Acquire创建Artifact |
| `PerceptionAcquisitionCommitDraft` | `DraftEnvelope + perceptionAcquisitionId + source{sourceId,sourceKind,sourceConfigRevision} + normalizationRuleRef + cursorTransition{pageOrdinal,expectedCursorRevision,cursorIn,cursorOut,observationPageDigest,hasMore} + records[{draftId,recordKind(observation|correction|retraction),sourceRecordKey,sourceRecordRevision,sourceRecordDigest,rating?,watchedState?,observedTitle,observedAtMs,identityAnchors[{anchorKind,anchorValue,confidenceClass,evidenceDigest}],provenanceRef,provenanceDigest}] + sourceLineageRelations[{relationKind(supersedes|retracts),sourceDraftId,targetSourceRecord{sourceRecordKey,sourceRecordRevision,sourceRecordDigest},ruleRevision,evidenceDigest}]`；单Draft只含一个Source的一页；Canonical rating仅`integer 1..5|null`，watchedState仅`boolean|null`；完整Draft digest是Commit Handle payloadDigest |
| `PerceptionRecordCommitResult` | `ReceiptEnvelope + acquisitionCommitReceiptId(=receiptId) + perceptionAcquisitionId + sourceId + committedCursorRevision + perceptionIds[] + relationIds[] + insertedCount + duplicateCount`；typed value内部不含自引用`resultDigest`；其canonical value由`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest`及`perception_acquisition_commits.result_digest`按同一basis校验，第一次提交与marker同事务保存，重放不得重算 |
| `PerceptionResolutionDraft` | `DraftEnvelope + queryContract + querySchemaRef + queryInputDigest + factKind + recordSetDigest + ruleRevision + ruleDigest + resultKind(found|not_found) + winningPerceptionId? + resolvedValue? + resolvedProvenance? + reasonCode? + duplicateRelationDrafts[{sourcePerceptionId,targetPerceptionId,ruleRevision,evidenceDigest}]`；`resolvedValue={factKind,value}`且rating value为integer `1..5`、watched value为boolean；`resolvedProvenance={winningPerceptionId,sourceKind,sourceRecordKey,sourceRecordRevision,provenanceRef,provenanceDigest,matchedAnchorEvidence[{anchorKind,strengthRank,evidenceDigest}]}`且Anchor数组按strength/key稳定排序；found必须携带winner/value/provenance且reason为空；not_found不得携带winner/value/provenance，reason固定为`no_matching_record|requested_fact_absent|strongest_value_conflict`；duplicate pair必须规范化且只来自Rule Snapshot的duplicate proof matcher，不因fuzzy match或相同value生成 |
| `PerceptionResolutionRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + queryContract + querySchemaRef + queryInputDigest + factKind + recordSetDigest + ruleRevision + ruleDigest + resultKind + winningPerceptionId? + resolvedValue? + resolvedProvenance? + reasonCode? + committedRelationIds[]`；resolved value/provenance沿用Draft的精确schema，完整保存并由Resolution Facade返回，不允许Facade旁读Foundation或重新执行Policy拼装结果 |
| `PersonRegistrationEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + originKind(provider_hint|ondeck_nfo_projection) + originRef + originRevision + originEvidenceDigest + proposedName + aliases[{aliasDisplay,aliasNormalized,provenanceDigest}] + providerIdentities[{provider,namespace,providerKey,provenanceDigest}] + referenceHints[{hintKind,referenceValue,provenanceDigest}]`；数组有界，大型引用只能使用typed handle/ref；referenceHints不是已导入Reference Image，也不是联网图片搜索结果 |
| `PeopleCandidateDraft` | `DraftEnvelope + candidateKind(registration|merge) + evidenceDigest + candidatePayload + candidatePayloadDigest`；Registration payload恰为`{proposedName,aliases[],providerIdentities[],referenceHints[]}`并沿用`PersonRegistrationEvidence`成员schema；Merge payload恰为`{leftPersonRef{personId,revision,factDigest,preferenceRevision(null|positive)},rightPersonRef{personId,revision,factDigest,preferenceRevision(null|positive)},matchSignals[],conflictSummary,evidenceRefs[]}`且pair按personId规范化；`candidatePayloadDigest=SHA-256(JCS(candidatePayload))`，digest字段与Draft envelope均不进入该basis；完整Draft≤`16 KiB`，大Evidence只含handle/ref |
| `PeopleCandidateRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + candidateKind + candidateId + candidateRevision + candidateSchemaRef + candidatePayloadDigest + evidenceDigest + state(open|accepted|dismissed|superseded)`；candidate revision与payload可由People Store精确恢复 |
| `PersonReferenceRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + personId + referenceRevision + operationKind(add_image|release_image) + affectedReferenceAssetId + affectedReferenceFaceId + activeReferenceAssets[{referenceAssetId,artifactHandleId,artifactDigest}] + activeReferenceFaces[{referenceFaceId,referenceAssetId,embeddingHandleId,embeddingDigest,modelRef}] + activeAssetSetDigest + activeFaceSetDigest + referenceSetDigest`；ID排序统一比较exact ID的UTF-8 bytes升序，禁止locale/case-fold；Asset/Face ID重复直接拒绝。`activeAssetSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"people.reference-active-assets@1",items:activeReferenceAssets按referenceAssetId排序}))`；`activeFaceSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"people.reference-active-faces@1",items:activeReferenceFaces按referenceFaceId排序}))`；`referenceSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"people.reference-set@1",personId,activeAssetSetDigest,activeFaceSetDigest}))`；`factDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整PersonReferenceRevision excluding factDigest))`，其他三个digest及两个完整数组均保留在basis中；Face始终与唯一Asset共同建立/释放 |
| `MergeCandidateEvidence` | `EvidenceEnvelope + personPair[{personId,revision,factDigest,preferenceRevision(null|positive)}] + matchSignals[] + conflictSummary + evidenceRefs[]`；pair按personId规范化，引用精确People revision；NULL明确表示当前没有Preference revision |
| `PersonRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + operationKind(registration|merge) + registrationOrigin(direct|candidate)? + personId(primary/new target) + canonicalName + aliasSetDigest + providerIdentitySetDigest + directDecisionRef? + acceptedCandidateRef?{candidateKind,candidateId,candidateRevision,candidatePayloadDigest} + affectedPersonRevisions[{personId,revision,status,factDigest}] + mergeRecordRef? + preferenceRevisionRef?`；direct Registration必须有`directDecisionRef`且无Candidate ref，Candidate Registration/Merge反之；Merge Result同时返回target新revision和source terminal revision，marker重放返回同一完整value |
| `PersonPreferenceRevision` | `DomainFactEnvelope + personId + preferenceLevel(-2..2) + reason` |

`FaceEmbeddingSetHandle`、`FaceClusterSetHandle`、`WorkerAssetReceipt`、`WorkerUploadReceipt`、`ArtifactHandle`、
`WorkspaceMaterialHandle`、`ExternalJobReceipt`和`TargetCommitSlotHandle`直接使用`8.6.18`定义，不重复包装。

#### 8.6.20 Input schema、parameter与semantic validator边界

Catalog input使用三类schema：

1. **Accepted Business DTO**：`SelectedFieldMaterialSet`、`ProcurementRunExecutionBasis`、
   `ProcurementRunSealDecision`、`ProcurementRetryIntent`、`CandidatePackage`、`PrimaryInputManifest`、
   `ShelfStandard`、`AcceptanceSpec`、`FinalInventoryDecision`、`DirectPersonRegistrationDecision`、`PeopleCandidateAcceptanceDecision`、
   `PeopleReferenceMaintenanceDecision`、`DestructionScope`等必须包含对象ID、revision、
   digest和Level 3–5定义的成员；Executor只能读Plan冻结的DTO snapshot；
2. **Typed Handle/Projection**：使用`8.6.18`字段或versioned public Query Projection；不得传Store row、裸路径
   或跨Domain可变对象；
3. **Bounded Intent/Requirement**：`BoundedFingerprintProfile`、`SamplingPlan`、`EncodeIntent`、`RemuxIntent`、
   `MediaRequirement`、`SelectionCriteria`、`ArtifactRequirement`等必须包含`intent/requirementId, revision,
   schemaRef, digest`，且只描述当前单效果所需参数。

Media Production是上述通则的closed specialization，不允许生成器退化为旧generic schema：

- `libra.transcode.input.verify@1`的exact named inputs为`sourceMaterialHandle,sourceProbeEvidence,encodeIntent,
  deviceSnapshot`；`selectedDeviceClass`物化为scalar string，四项都必须进入Event immutable input binding；
- `libra.media.remux@1`的exact named inputs为`sourceMaterialHandle,remuxIntent,outputTarget`；
  `libra.media.transcode@1`追加`deviceSnapshot,transcodeInputVerification`，其passed basis必须逐项命中同一Handle、
  Probe、Intent和Device Snapshot。两项Effect的idempotency key固定为`SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-media-effect-key@1",capabilityRef,eventId,sourceHandleDigest,productionIntentDigest,
  outputTargetId,outputTargetDigest}))`；pre-effect fence重验Workspace state/root/target containment，Effect receipt绑定
  target、实际output digest和Foundation Handle registration。重启只恢复或核对同一Effect，不重新选Device/路径；
- `libra.product_media.verify@1`的唯一exact named input为`productMediaCandidateInput`，其closed union完整携带
  direct input或workspace output的Handle/Probe/Requirement；`mediaProbeRef`字符串与第二Handle ID从schema删除；
- `libra.product_output.select@1`只接受完整`ProductOutputSelectionInput@1`；
  `libra.product.conformance.verify@1`只接受完整`ProductConformanceInputSnapshot@1`。这两项pure Executor不得声明
  Domain/Foundation/Platform Store read dependency。

Machine type registry必须为`EncodeIntent@1`、`RemuxIntent@1`与`MediaRequirement@1`分别生成8.6.18的exact
`additionalProperties:false` schema；`EncodeIntent@1.intentDigest`与`RemuxIntent@1.intentDigest`是唯一Intent
摘要字段，旧`digest`、`targetQuality`、generic `audioCodec`或`typedParameters`均不是别名或兼容输入。
`ProductConformanceInputSnapshot@1`与`WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot@1`的nested schema必须以exact `$ref/oneOf`引用
`ResolvedProviderIdentity@1`、三个closed Product Fact value、`ArtifactManifestVerification@1`、
`ProductionMaterialManifest@1`、`ArtifactManifest@1`、`SelectedProductOutput@1`与
`ProductMediaVerification@1`；Workspace Product Verification还必须保留本节role-aware
`media|artifact|structural` closed union，Schema materializer遇到同名旧bounded-contract不得合并、降级或生成第二条路径。

`LibraProductionCoordinator`负责在Event Attempt前组装Conformance input，但它不是新Capability、Owner或Store：
它只按Run冻结的Acceptance Spec、显式Product Fact ID/revision、Product Staging Reference、Material Manifest以及
`VerifiedArtifactManifest.items[].verificationResultRef`的精确ID读取typed Owner/Public Result；禁止按Run扫描
latest/current Fact或无关Foundation Result。Coordinator逐项重建完整值、验证schema/digest/ref后形成上述Snapshot，
Runtime把完整Snapshot作为immutable named input并冻结`inputBindingDigest/snapshotDigest`。pure Executor只复验
Snapshot内部闭包并执行六组规则，不再次证明数据库历史，也没有任何Query port；装配阶段缺失、stale或digest冲突
在调用Executor前就是input integrity failure。该Snapshot与passed `ProductConformanceEvidence@1`的
`productSnapshotDigest`随后被P9-08 Attestation逐字节引用，因此Attestation不需要回读Fact/Artifact/Material Store。

`PlatformComputeRuntimePort`是既有Platform typed runtime port族的只读扩充，不属于Catalog Capability。Planner只能
冻结found Snapshot；Device在执行前失效时由fence形成stable failure并交回Runtime/Planner，Executor不得隐藏fallback。
`deviceClass=remote_worker`时，Composition Root只能按Snapshot.workerRef在Attempt开始时取得同revision/capability的
短期`WorkerHandle@1`并放入fence snapshot；WorkerHandle不改变选定Device，也不得指向另一Worker/revision。取得失败或
revision不匹配只产生fence rejection，不能回退本地Device。local Device禁止workerRef/WorkerHandle。
Media Production所有Probe都由既有`shared.material.media.probe@1`产生；转码/Remux Executor不得内部补Probe并把它
伪装为正式Evidence。上述细化不新增Owner、Store、Handoff或Canonical Transaction。

Procurement Triage另有一组仅在当前Run/Plan内有效、但必须生成正式Schema的closed input DTO：
`TriageMaterialProbeBatch`、`MaterialFieldContext`、`TriageStructurePageRequest`、
`TriageStructureInspectionInput`、`TriageUnitSnapshot`、`TriageIdentityResolutionInput`、
`TriageManifestBuildInput`与`CandidateDraft`。它们不得退化成由逗号拆词生成的generic `SelectedMaterials/Roles/
Structure/IdentityMetadata`；Schema必须把Member/Scope映射、`1..1024`总Physical Selection、`1..100`Probe Batch、digest、Rule
authority和Run Basis逐项表达。`PrimaryInputManifest.members[].ordinal`与所有Triage Unit/Selection稳定ordinal的
minimum固定为`0`，集合自身`minItems=1`；不得把“revision从1开始”的通用规则误套到ordinal。

Catalog摘要中的`cursor`、`pageBudget`、`phase`、`artifactKind`、`structureKind`和`contentProfile`全部属于
`parameters.schema.json`：

- cursor是opaque bounded string；pageBudget是正整数并由Control Plane上限裁剪；
- phase只允许Catalog声明的枚举；artifactKind、structureKind和contentProfile只允许前序Level词典中的枚举；
- Executor不能接受未知parameter，不能通过parameter改变Effect Class、Owner、Fence或Result type；
- `SemanticValidator`只验证单个Capability合同无法由JSON Schema表达的不变量，例如Manifest digest、路径
  containment、stream组合、Identity tuple和revision fence；它不能选择下一Capability或写业务Fact。

Reference语义校验必须证明`add_image`的Artifact与Embedding `sourceArtifactSetDigest`精确对应、Face/Vector count
均为1、Asset/Face ID未被使用且expected Person/reference revision仍current；`release_image`必须证明目标Asset
active、Face active且二者唯一关联。Metadata fetch校验必须证明Intent discriminator与Handle kind、Integration
type或Related Reference digest精确匹配。任何一项失败都不得通过Executor默认值、按数组取首项或Store旁读补齐。

PBF-13 Application DTO同样必须生成正式Schema：Run/Workspace/Package/Cleanup Decision不得退化为
`objectIds[] + digest`；`ProductionMaterialManifest`、`OnDeckProductPackage`和Cleanup member的完整成员只可使用本节
closed结构。大Package经Handoff Port按16 MiB上限读取，Commit Event Result只使用bounded Receipt，不能为了通过
Foundation 64 KiB限制截断Package或把Owner业务事实藏入Artifact/Result fallback。
`fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json`只保存versioned typed binding refs；Run/Promotion等大Decision由Coordinator在提交
边界按这些精确refs装配。可变current input必须携带expected revision/digest并在Canonical Transaction重验，immutable
input只可从本Domain Owner rows、Foundation Control/Workspace historical rows或正式typed跨Domain Query Result展开；
Capability Executor本身不得读Store。装配后的完整Decision可以超过16 KiB，但不得作为单个Plan JSON/Event Result
持久化；commit成功后的全部业务成员必须由本节relation rows永久重建，commit前崩溃只重新装配并接受同一CAS结果。

Contract build必须机械证明：Catalog每个ref恰好对应一个manifest；manifest引用的每个type/schema存在；所有
input/output `$ref`闭合；Effect Class与8.6.3–8.6.14一致；Catalog之外的Executor无法注册。以当前Draft计，
clean Catalog为`112 refs / 112 unique / 0 unresolved output family`。

#### 8.6.21 Libra Run、Workspace、Deliverable与Reclamation typed contract

本节只把Level 3/6已经确认的Libra业务责任变成可持久化、可CAS和可历史重建的formal DTO；这些Application
Decision/Result、Facade Read DTO和内部typed Message不新增Catalog Capability或Result family。除另有说明外，集合
ID按exact UTF-8 bytes升序，禁止locale/case-fold；所有digest均为小写hex `SHA-256(JCS(value))`，digest字段自身不
进入其basis；数组必须已去重，越界或顺序错误稳定拒绝而不是由Commit Participant整理。

**Run input、scope与state：**

- `ProductionMaterialManifest@1`固定为
  `{manifestId,manifestRole(run_input|product_delivery),manifestRevision,libraRunId,
  scopeKind(single|episode_delivery),members[1..1024],memberSetDigest,
  episodeScopeDigest,manifestDigest}`。member逐项为
  `{ordinal,materialKey,role(primary_payload|structural_dependency|metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart|subtitle|
  external_audio|chapter|sidecar),physicalIdentity{mountScopeId,inode,sizeBytes,fingerprintAlgorithm,contentFingerprint},sizeBytes,
  location{locationKind(domain_binding|workspace_handle),endpointId,location?,rootHandleRef?,relativePath?},
  bindingKind(libra_material_binding|workspace_material_reference),bindingRevision,
  bindingEvidenceDigest,originCandidateDeliveryRef?{intakeDecisionId,offerId,candidatePackageId,packageRevision,
  packageDigest,candidateDeliverySnapshotDigest,relatedReferenceSetDigest},workspaceReferenceId?,
  workspaceMaterialHandle?,admittedControlRevision?,
  admittedControlProjectionDigest?,outputRequirementDigest,
  episodeClaims[0..32 {episodeKey,seasonClaimDigest,claimDigest}],episodeClaimSetDigest,memberDigest}`；
  `claimDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.production-material-episode-claim@1",episodeKey,seasonClaimDigest}))`；members按
  materialKey排序后从0赋ordinal，Episode claims按episodeKey排序。run_input及direct-original固定
  `locationKind=domain_binding,bindingKind=libra_material_binding`、origin/admitted Control pair非NULL且workspace/root-relative字段为NULL；Workspace Product固定
  `locationKind=workspace_handle`且location字段为NULL，endpoint/root/relative逐字节等于Handle，并固定
  `bindingKind=workspace_material_reference,originCandidateDeliveryRef/admittedControl pair=NULL`，binding revision/evidence逐字节等于同Run current Product Staging
  Reference，并内联其完整typed Workspace Handle。`memberDigest=SHA-256(JCS(member excluding
  memberDigest))`；`episodeClaimSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.production-material-episode-claims@1",items:episodeClaims}))`；`memberSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-material-members@1",items:
  members}))`；`episodeScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-episode-scope@1",items:
  去重episodeClaims按episodeKey排序}))`；同一episodeKey被多个Material覆盖时三字段必须逐字节相同，否则Manifest
  稳定拒绝；single必须为空scope，season至少一项；`manifestDigest=SHA-256(JCS(
  完整value excluding manifestDigest))`；`manifestId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-material-manifest-id@1",
  manifestRole,libraRunId,manifestRevision}))`。Run input固定role=`run_input`,revision=1；Product delivery固定
  role=`product_delivery`,revision=Package revision，二者不得复用ID。run_input只允许
  `primary_payload|structural_dependency`；product_delivery至少一个primary，其他role按Spec可选且只有primary允许
  Episode Claim。Run Admission构造run_input时，Physical Identity/size/Location必须逐项取自current immutable
  `libra_material_bindings` revision并满足`PhysicalMaterialIdentity@2`的materialKey公式；该Binding的Handoff A origin
  又必须回指同一historical Candidate Delivery Snapshot，禁止从materialKey反解、读取current Procurement Field或由caller补值。
  Episode Delivery成员本身没有`pending|delivered`状态；Run Input与Product Deliverable各自是immutable Manifest，
  业务推进只由Run revision、Package revision与Arca Inventory事实表达，禁止原地修改Episode member冒充交付。
- 每个member的`outputRequirementDigest`不是caller提供的opaque值，也不是由Planner选择六类Requirement的某个
  子集。它唯一来自同Run immutable `AcceptanceSpec@1`与本member事实。先定义
  `acceptanceRequirementSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.acceptance-requirement-set@1",
  requirements:acceptanceSpec.requirements}))`；六类Requirement完整对象必须按8.6.18规则规范化，不能只使用
  `specDigest`替代该typed value。
- `ProductionMaterialOutputRequirement@1`固定为
  `{acceptanceSpecRef{acceptanceSpecId,specRevision,specDigest,recordDigest,productScopeDigest},
  manifestRole(run_input|product_delivery),materialKey,materialRole,
  applicationScope{kind(product_scope|episode_subset|production_support),episodeKeys[],scopeDigest},
  acceptanceRequirementSetDigest,
  outputRequirementDigest}`。`applicationScope.scopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.production-material-requirement-scope@1",productScopeDigest:acceptanceSpec.productScope.scopeDigest,
  kind,episodeKeys}))`，episodeKeys总是去重并按UTF-8 bytes排序；
  `outputRequirementDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding outputRequirementDigest))`。
- 映射是closed且无Planner自由度：single `primary_payload`使用`product_scope+[]`；season
  `primary_payload`使用`episode_subset+本member全部episodeClaims中的episodeKey`，要求1..32项且必须是Acceptance
  Spec Product Scope的非空子集。`structural_dependency`固定`production_support+[]`，明确它只参与生产且不单独
  声称满足最终产品要求；`metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart|subtitle|external_audio|chapter|sidecar`固定`product_scope+[]`。
  具体责任仍由`materialRole`保留，不能把多种role压成同一digest。run_input只会命中primary/structural两个分支；
  product_delivery按实际role命中对应分支。所有分支都绑定完整六类Requirement；该binding只说明Material属于哪份
  产品要求及其作用范围，不声称单个Material独立满足整份Spec，也不把Acceptance Policy拆成member-local Policy。
- Run Admission从`libra_runs.acceptance_spec_id → libra_acceptance_specs`的immutable Spec、Run Manifest/member/Episode
  relation重算每项typed value；Deliverable Promotion从Package与Run共同引用的同一Spec及Product
  Manifest/member/Episode relation重算。两者都必须逐字节等于持久化`output_requirement_digest`并进入member/
  manifest digest。历史恢复只使用这些Libra Owner rows；不得读取current Spec、caller cache、Foundation Result或
  另一Domain Store补值。该typed binding是application data contract，不新增Capability、Result family或表。
- `LibraRunExecutionBasis@1`固定为
  `{subjectSnapshot{subjectId,intakeRevision,structureKind,contentProfile,continuitySetDigest,episodeScopeDigest},
  decisionHeadSnapshot(SubjectDecisionHeadSnapshot),acceptanceSpec{acceptanceSpecId,specRevision,specDigest,
  recordDigest,productScopeDigest,shelfId},shelfProjection{routingProjectionRevision,projectionDigest,
  standardRevision,standardDigest},productionMaterialManifest,relatedDispositionScope{relatedReferenceSetDigest,
  relatedDispositionScopeDigest,items[0..1024]{referenceId,primaryMaterialKey,role,materialKey,
  associationEvidenceDigest,dispositionBasisDigest}},executionBasisDigest}`；Basis完整JCS≤`8 MiB`，
  `executionBasisDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  executionBasisDigest))`。Run Admission写入后该Basis不可改写，所有成员都能由Run/Manifest/Binding snapshot
  Owner rows恢复；Related Disposition Scope从Handoff A accepted Delivery Snapshot和Libra `related_derived` Binding逐项
  冻结，后续Product/Off-load必须完整覆盖；历史恢复只通过冻结的exact origin ref调用Handoff A historical
  `CandidateDeliveryPort`并校验snapshot/set/scope digest，不旁读Procurement Store。不得用后来current Subject、Spec、
  Binding或Control补历史。Priority是Run-local scheduling fact，不属于产物目标或Execution Basis；Priority变化不得
  改变`executionBasisDigest`或触发replacement Run。
- `LibraRunExecutionBasisRecord@1`与上述Basis字段逐项相同，但把完整
  `productionMaterialManifest`替换为`productionMaterialManifestRef{manifestId,manifestDigest,memberCount,
  episodeScopeDigest}`；Record本身不另造semantic digest。历史重建必须先读该typed record，再从本Run immutable
  Manifest/member/Episode relation展开完整Basis并重算`executionBasisDigest`；Record缺字段或Manifest不一致是
  integrity failure，不能读取current Subject/Decision Head/Shelf Projection补齐。
- `runScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-scope@1",subjectId,structureKind,contentProfile,
  productScopeDigest,episodeScopeDigest,productionMaterialManifestDigest}))`。admission提交前的
  `expectedRunAdmissionHead={headState(absent|present),headRevision,activeScopeSetDigest}`；absent固定revision 0与
  `SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.active-run-scopes@1",subjectId,items:[]}))`；present的headRevision必须为正整数。
  `headState=absent`当且仅当不存在`libra_run_admission_heads` row且headRevision=0，不能以存储revision 1伪装
  pre-CAS absent state，也不能建立revision 0 sentinel row。
- `LibraRunAdmissionDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,admissionKind(initial|replacement),subjectId,admissionRevision,libraRunId,
  replacementOfRunRef?,expectedRunAdmissionHead,runExecutionBasis,
  initialPriority{priorityClass(normal|expedited),priorityIntentDigest},runScopeDigest,decisionDigest}`；
  `admissionRevision=expectedHeadRevision+1`，`libraRunId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-id@1",subjectId,
  admissionRevision}))`；先由该ID派生Manifest ID并形成Manifest/Run Scope/Basis；decision digest覆盖完整value。
  replacement ref固定旧`{libraRunId,stateRevision,stateDigest,runScopeDigest,acceptanceSpecId,
  executionBasisDigest}`且只允许相同Subject/Episode交付scope，并要求Acceptance Spec record digest或
  Execution Basis digest至少一项变化；initial不得携带该ref。initial Priority恒为`normal`且intent digest固定为
  `SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.priority-intent-empty@1"}))`；replacement必须逐字节复制旧Run current Priority，不能由
  caller借replacement提权。`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-admission-decision-id@1",libraRunId,executionBasisDigest,
  initialPriority.priorityClass,initialPriority.priorityIntentDigest}))`。
  “相同Subject/Episode交付scope”固定比较`subjectId + structureKind + ProductScope.scopeKind + 去重排序episodeKeys`；
  不比较包含Material Manifest digest的`runScopeDigest`，否则合法的Binding/Material变化将永远无法建立replacement。
- `LibraRunAdmissionResult@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunId,admissionRevision,stateRevision(1),stateDigest,executionBasisDigest,runScopeDigest,
  productionMaterialManifestId,priorityClass,priorityIntentDigest,committedAdmissionHeadRevision,activeScopeSetDigest,
  supersededRunRef?{libraRunId,committedStateRevision,committedStateDigest},resultDigest}`。
  initial state恒为active；`stateDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-state@1",libraRunId,stateRevision,state,
  acceptanceSpecId,executionBasisDigest,runScopeDigest,priorityClass,priorityIntentDigest,transitionKind,
  transitionEvidenceDigest}))`。
- `LibraRunComparableBasisSnapshot@1`固定为
  `{subjectId,structureKind,contentProfile,acceptanceSpecRef{acceptanceSpecId,specRevision,specDigest,recordDigest},
  productScopeDigest,members[1..1024 {materialKey,role,physicalIdentity,sizeBytes,bindingRevision,
  bindingEvidenceDigest,episodeClaimSetDigest,controlRevision,controlProjectionDigest,outputRequirementDigest,
  memberComparisonDigest}],memberSetDigest,comparableBasisDigest}`。members按materialKey UTF-8 bytes升序且逐项只从
  Libra immutable Subject/Spec/Binding/Episode relation与Foundation current或historical Control snapshot构造；
  完整Snapshot仍逐字节保存`acceptanceSpecId/specRevision/recordDigest`与每个member的正式
  `outputRequirementDigest`作为provenance Evidence，但Freshness语义比较不得把这些记录身份误当成产品要求变化。
  每个member先计算`outputRequirementSemanticDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.output-requirement-semantic@1",acceptanceSpecDigest:acceptanceSpecRef.specDigest,
  productScopeDigest,materialKey,materialRole:role,episodeClaimSetDigest}))`；再计算
  `memberComparisonDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-comparable-member-semantic@1",materialKey,
  role,physicalIdentity,sizeBytes,bindingRevision,bindingEvidenceDigest,episodeClaimSetDigest,controlRevision,
  controlProjectionDigest,outputRequirementSemanticDigest}))`。
  `memberSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-comparable-member-set@1",
  items:[{materialKey,memberComparisonDigest}]}))`；`comparableBasisDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-comparable-basis-semantic@1",subjectId,structureKind,contentProfile,
  acceptanceSpecDigest:acceptanceSpecRef.specDigest,productScopeDigest,memberSetDigest}))`。因此新的Spec record若
  `specDigest`相同且Material/Binding/Control/Product Scope未变，必须得到`same`并继续原Run；不得仅因
  `acceptanceSpecId/specRevision/recordDigest`或由它们绑定出的正式`outputRequirementDigest`变化而replacement。
  完整JCS≤`1 MiB`。原始Snapshot
  必须从Run immutable Execution Basis/Manifest及其admitted Control historical revisions重建；current Snapshot必须从
  current ready Acceptance Spec、同一Product Scope的current Binding/Episode relation和Libra-owned current Control形成。
  它排除runId/admission revision等生产批次字段，只比较会改变产品要求或初始生产资料的事实。
- `LibraRunRecoveryPolicySnapshot@1`是Libra-owned、随binary immutable的Beta合同：
  `{policyRef:"libra.run-recovery.beta@1",policyRevision:1,assessmentOffsetsMs:[60000,300000,900000,
  1800000,3600000],maxRecoveryAssessments:5,heavyPermitAllowed:false,frozenAutoResumeAllowed:false,policyDigest}`；
  `policyDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding policyDigest))`。Composition Root注入并启动校验；它不是用户Policy、
  Store、Capability或新的逻辑组件，改变数组/预算必须发布新revision，既有suspended Run继续使用自己冻结的Snapshot。
- `LibraRunFreshnessAssessment@1`固定为
  `{assessmentId,libraRunId,expectedState{state,stateRevision,stateDigest},assessmentKind(active_checkpoint|
  suspension_recovery),recoveryPolicy(LibraRunRecoveryPolicySnapshot),recoveryEpisode{startedAtMs?,attemptOrdinal,
  dueAtMs?},assessedAtMs,currentDecisionHead(SubjectDecisionHeadSnapshot),originalBasis(
  LibraRunComparableBasisSnapshot),readiness(ready|unresolved),currentBasis?,unresolvedReasonCodes[],
  dimensionResults[{dimension(acceptance_spec|product_scope|material_binding|material_control|output_requirement),
  result(same|changed|unresolved),evidenceDigest}],comparison(same|changed|unresolved),assessmentDigest}`。
  active checkpoint固定attempt 0；首次unresolved suspend以`startedAtMs=assessedAtMs,attemptOrdinal=0,dueAtMs=
  startedAtMs+60000`冻结恢复episode。suspension recovery只允许attempt `1..5`，必须恰好等于current attempt+1且
  `assessedAtMs>=startedAtMs+assessmentOffsetsMs[attempt-1]`；attempt 1..4 unresolved计算下一offset，attempt 5
  unresolved必须frozen。ready必须携带currentBasis且reason为空，按两个`comparableBasisDigest`产生same|changed；
  unresolved禁止currentBasis并至少一个closed reason：`decision_basis_unresolved|acceptance_spec_unavailable|
  product_scope_unresolved|material_binding_unavailable|material_control_unavailable|required_query_unresolved`。
  dimension按上述固定顺序恰好五项；任何Owner-row/digest不完整是integrity fault，不伪装成unresolved。
  `assessmentId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-freshness-assessment-id@1",libraRunId,
  expectedStateRevision:expectedState.stateRevision,assessmentKind,attemptOrdinal:recoveryEpisode.attemptOrdinal,
  currentDecisionHeadDigest:currentDecisionHead.snapshotDigest}))`；`assessmentDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  assessmentDigest))`，完整JCS≤`1 MiB`。
- `LibraRunPriorityIntent@1`固定为
  `{intentId,libraRunId,actorId,idempotencyKey,expectedPriorityClass,requestedPriorityClass(normal|expedited),
  intentKind(accelerate|cancel_acceleration),issuedAtMs,intentDigest}`；accelerate只允许`normal→expedited`，cancel只允许
  `expedited→normal`，且Level 9现有入口只对active Run开放。`intentId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-priority-intent-id@1",libraRunId,actorId,idempotencyKey}))`，`intentDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  intentDigest))`；它是set_priority的唯一typed Authorization Evidence，相同key/内容重放原Result，key相同内容不同拒绝。
- `LibraRunTerminalDeliveryEvidence@1`固定为
  `{evidenceId,libraRunId,executionBasisDigest,blockerKind(capability_exhausted|integration_exhausted|
  product_unachievable),blockedWorks[1..256 {workId,planId,workBasisDigest,terminalEventId,capabilityRef,
  failureClass,failureCode,attemptCount,retryPolicyDigest,terminalEvidenceDigest,memberDigest}],blockerSetDigest,
  assessedAtMs,evidenceDigest}`；members按workId/eventId排序且只能从同Run immutable Plan、terminal Event/Attempt rows和
  对应versioned Retry Policy重建；`workId+terminalEventId`必须唯一，先按workId、再按terminalEventId的UTF-8 bytes
  升序。`memberDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-terminal-blocker-member@1",workId,planId,
  workBasisDigest,terminalEventId,capabilityRef,failureClass,failureCode,attemptCount,retryPolicyDigest,
  terminalEvidenceDigest}))`；`blockerSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-terminal-blocker-set@1",libraRunId,executionBasisDigest,blockerKind,items:blockedWorks}))`，items是上述
  排序后的完整member（含memberDigest），不能只覆盖ID或由数组输入顺序决定。`evidenceId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-terminal-delivery-evidence-id@1",libraRunId,executionBasisDigest,blockerKind,blockerSetDigest,
  assessedAtMs}))`；`evidenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding evidenceDigest))`。同一evidenceId必须逐字节得到
  同一完整Evidence，重放不得刷新assessedAtMs或重排members。它只授权
  `active→frozen`的“产品手段已确定耗尽”路径，不用于Decision Basis unresolved；资源等待、可重试Provider故障或
  单个非terminal Event不得形成该Evidence。完整JCS≤`256 KiB`，写入Run revision后不得依赖Foundation Result JSON补值。
- `LibraRunLifecycleDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunId,expectedStateRevision,expectedStateDigest,transitionKind(suspend|resume|freeze|
  freshness_confirmed|recovery_reassessed|set_priority|complete),newPriority{priorityClass,priorityIntentDigest}?,
  transitionEvidence(LibraRunFreshnessAssessment|LibraRunTerminalDeliveryEvidence|LibraRunPriorityIntent|
  ArcaProductAcceptedMessage),
  expectedAdmissionHeadRevision,expectedActiveScopeSetDigest,decisionDigest}`；Decision ID由Run、expected revision、
  transition kind、Evidence digest及new Priority digest稳定派生：`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-lifecycle-decision-id@1",libraRunId,expectedStateRevision,transitionKind,
  transitionEvidenceDigest,newPriorityDigest?}))`，其中newPriorityDigest为newPriority完整JCS digest，非set_priority
  variant固定NULL。`transitionEvidenceDigest`按nominal type唯一映射：Freshness取`assessmentDigest`，Terminal
  Delivery取`evidenceDigest`，Priority取`intentDigest`，complete取
  `SHA-256(JCS(完整ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1))`；`transition_evidence_schema_ref/id/digest`分别保存该nominal
  schema、`assessmentId|evidenceId|intentId|messageId`与上述digest，禁止Coordinator另选摘要basis。
  `LibraRunLifecycleResult@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunId,previousStateRevision,previousStateDigest,committedState,committedStateRevision,
  committedStateDigest,committedAdmissionHeadRevision,activeScopeSetDigest,deliveryReceiptId?,terminalAtMs?,
  resultDigest}`；相同Decision marker只返回原Result。
  `suspend|resume|freeze|freshness_confirmed|recovery_reassessed`必须携带完整
  `LibraRunFreshnessAssessment@1`：active+ready/same只允许freshness_confirmed且保持active；active+unresolved只允许
  suspend；suspended+ready/same只允许resume；suspended+unresolved attempt 1..4只允许recovery_reassessed并保持
  suspended；attempt 5 unresolved只允许freeze。active→frozen只允许完整`LibraRunTerminalDeliveryEvidence@1`，
  不能用它绕过suspended freshness恢复。ready/changed不走Lifecycle transaction，而由同Assessment作为
  replacement Admission中旧Run superseded revision的Evidence；Run Creator必须原子建立replacement，不能先单独
  supersede。`complete` Evidence必须是同Run唯一accepted `ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1`及其中Receipt，允许从
  active或suspended完成并以Offer/Package/Receipt fence解决竞态；既有Delivery Receipt/Inbox合同已经充分，不新增
  Freshness自检。`superseded`只能由Run Admission replacement atomic variant建立。只有`set_priority`携带
  newPriority并保持active state，其Evidence必须是匹配的`LibraRunPriorityIntent@1`且new Priority/digest逐字节相等；
  其他variant newPriority必须为NULL。frozen只允许另一个Run Discard事务，Lifecycle稳定拒绝全部自动恢复。

**Workspace aggregate与Material Reference：**

- `PlatformWorkspaceRuntimePort@1`只暴露两个typed method：
  `resolveWorkspaceRoot(PlatformWorkspaceRootQuery@1) → PlatformWorkspaceRootReadResult@1`与
