  `assessWorkspaceSpace(WorkspaceSpaceAdmissionRequest@1) → WorkspaceSpaceAdmissionEvidence@1`。前者固定Query为
  `{rootId,expectedConfigRevision?,queryDigest}`，`queryDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding queryDigest))`；Result为
  `{queryDigest,resultKind(found|not_found|stale|inactive|integrity_error),snapshot?,reasonCode?,resultDigest}`，found恰含
  `PlatformWorkspaceRootSnapshot@1`，其他variant不得含snapshot，`resultDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  resultDigest))`。不存在root返回not_found；expected config不匹配返回stale；current state非active返回inactive；
  Owner row不能重算匹配handle/snapshot digest返回integrity_error；只有其余情况返回found。这是对既有P5
  `resolveWorkspaceRoot` runtime port的正式重签，不新增Capability或组件；旧的
  `resolvedRoot`输出从public合同删除，只能留在Platform内部实现用于containment/statvfs。
- `PlatformWorkspaceRootSnapshot@1`固定为
  `{rootId,ownerScope(libra),rootKind,endpointId,mountScopeId,mountScopeRevision,configRevision,
  capabilityDigest,state(active),rootHandleRef,
  snapshotDigest}`；`rootHandleRef=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"platform.workspace-root-handle@1",rootId,
  endpointId,mountScopeId,mountScopeRevision,configRevision,capabilityDigest}))`，`snapshotDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding snapshotDigest))`。它由
  Platform只读Query从`platform_workspace_roots`形成；Libra只保存opaque root handle与snapshot事实，不读取或复制
  `resolved_root`。
- `WorkspaceSpaceAdmissionRequest@1`固定为
  `{workspaceId,libraRunId,executionBasisDigest,rootId,rootSnapshotDigest,inputPrimaryTotalBytes,requiredFreeBytes,
  requestDigest}`；`inputPrimaryTotalBytes`只从Run immutable Primary members的`sizeBytes`求和，所有byte值均为
  non-negative safe integer。Beta固定使用Level 10 fallback公式
  `requiredFreeBytes=ceil(inputPrimaryTotalBytes*120/100)+5368709120`；任一步溢出safe integer不截断而返回
  `demand_out_of_range`。`requestDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding requestDigest))`。
- `WorkspaceSpaceAdmissionEvidence@1`固定为
  `{evidenceId,authorityRef:"platform.workspace-space-admission@1",requestDigest,workspaceId,libraRunId,rootId,
  rootSnapshotDigest,requiredBytes,availableBytes?,observedAtMs,expiresAtMs,result(admitted|insufficient_space|
  root_unavailable|demand_out_of_range),reasonCode?,evidenceDigest}`；Platform runtime port只能使用同一active Root
  Snapshot对应的内部`resolved_root`执行有界statvfs，输出不得含路径。admitted要求`availableBytes>=requiredBytes`
  且无reason；其他variant必须使用同名reason code，`availableBytes`只在成功取得statvfs时存在；
  `expiresAtMs=observedAtMs+30000`，`evidenceId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "platform.workspace-space-admission-evidence-id@1",requestDigest,rootSnapshotDigest,observedAtMs}))`，
  `evidenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding evidenceDigest))`，完整JCS≤`16 KiB`。它是Platform technical
  observation，不是Domain Fact、Catalog Capability Result或容量Reservation；每次Workspace写效果仍须按Level 10
  空间规则重新验证，不得因旧admitted Evidence绕过实际空间不足。
- `LibraWorkspaceAdmissionDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunRef{libraRunId,stateRevision,stateDigest,executionBasisDigest},workspaceId,
  platformWorkspaceRootSnapshot,spaceAdmissionEvidence(WorkspaceSpaceAdmissionEvidence),workspaceScopeDigest,
  decisionDigest}`；`workspaceId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-id@1",libraRunId}))`，scope digest覆盖Run、
  Platform Snapshot与允许的root/containment ref，不携带裸任意路径；其唯一formula为
  `workspaceScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-scope@1",workspaceId,libraRunRef,
  platformWorkspaceRootSnapshot,spaceAdmissionEvidence}))`；`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-admission-decision-id@1",workspaceId,libraRunRef.stateRevision,
  platformWorkspaceRootSnapshot.snapshotDigest,spaceAdmissionEvidence.evidenceDigest}))`。Evidence的workspace/run/root/
  snapshot/request basis必须逐项等于Decision，result必须admitted且提交时未过期；Decision digest覆盖完整value。
  `LibraWorkspaceAdmissionResult@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunId,workspaceId,platformWorkspaceRevision,workspaceRevision(1),workspaceState(active),
  workspaceStateDigest,resultDigest}`；initial Reference Set使用正式empty set digest，transitionKind=`admitted`、
  transitionEvidenceDigest=`decisionDigest`。
- `PBF-17`不改变“全部changed/new Workspace Product必须先进入Product Staging”的既有门禁，只修正其
  verification discriminator：Product verification必须证明该Material role要求的产品性质，而不是把所有文件都当作
  可播放媒体。`WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot@1`因此是同一门禁下的role-aware closed union。公共字段固定为
  `{verificationKind(media|artifact|structural),materialRole,libraRunId,workspaceMaterialHandleId,
  workspaceMaterialHandleDigest,workspaceMaterialFenceDigest,schemaRef,verificationId,verificationValue,
  verificationDigest,snapshotDigest}`；三个Handle字段必须逐字节命中同一完整`WorkspaceMaterialHandle@1`，
  `verificationId=verificationValue.verificationId`，`verificationDigest=SHA-256(JCS(verificationValue))`，
  `snapshotDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整Snapshot excluding snapshotDigest))`，完整Snapshot canonical JCS≤`128 KiB`：
  - `media`恰允许`materialRole=primary_payload`、`schemaRef=ProductMediaVerification@1`，其value必须是
    `libra.product_media.verify@1`的typed `candidateKind=workspace_output,result=passed` Result，并逐项命中同一Run、
    `productMaterialHandleId`、Handle digest及fence；
  - `artifact`恰允许`materialRole=metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart`、`schemaRef=ArtifactManifestVerification@1`，
    追加完整`artifactHandle(ArtifactHandle@1)`与`artifactRequirement(ArtifactRequirement@1)`；value必须来自
    `shared.artifact.manifest.verify@1`且`result=passed`，包含同一Handle/revision/kind/digest与Requirement。
    Commit同时按ID精确读取`fx_artifact_registry`，要求Artifact owner scope属于同一Libra Run/Workspace，并要求
    Artifact的digest algorithm/digest/size逐字节等于Workspace Material Handle的content hash/digest/size；
    role-kind固定映射为`metadata_sidecar→nfo`、`poster→poster`、`fanart→fanart`，不得把Artifact伪装成可播放媒体；
  - `structural`恰允许`materialRole=structural_dependency|subtitle|external_audio|chapter`、
    `schemaRef=ManifestVerification@1`，追加完整bounded `typedManifest`、`manifestContract`与
    `verifiedMemberDigest`；value必须来自`shared.manifest.verify@1`且`result=passed`，Manifest/Contract必须显式
    包含同一Run、同一Material role及同一Workspace Handle digest/fence，Result的manifest/contract basis逐字节匹配。
  任一分支的failed/not_applicable、另一Handle、另一Run、role/schema错配或digest不一致均稳定拒绝。
  Snapshot是Reference Commit的完整正式输入，Commit不旁读Foundation Event Result、caller cache或当前文件Reality；
  提交成功后由Libra reference row永久重建。`product_verification_id=verificationId`，
  `product_verification_digest=snapshotDigest`，不能只保存内部Result digest而丢失role/Handle binding。
- `WorkspaceMaterialReferenceSnapshot@1`固定为
  `{referenceId,workspaceId,libraRunId,materialHandleId,materialKey,workspaceMaterialHandle(WorkspaceMaterialHandle),
  workspaceHandleDigest,referenceRevision,
  state(working|product_staging|released),episodeClaims[0..32 {episodeKey,seasonClaimDigest,claimDigest}],
  episodeScopeDigest,productVerificationRef(WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot)?,previousReferenceRevision?,
  committedWorkspaceRevision,
  referenceDigest}`；`referenceId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-reference-id@1",workspaceId,
  materialHandleId}))`；Episode claims按episodeKey排序且沿用`ProductionMaterialManifest@1`的单项/set公式，
  `episodeScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.production-episode-scope@1",items:episodeClaims}))`；
  `workspaceHandleDigest=SHA-256(JCS(workspaceMaterialHandle))`且逐字节等于Foundation/Libra row的handle digest；
  `referenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding referenceDigest))`。
  `LibraWorkspaceMaterialReferenceDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,operation(attach_working|promote_to_product_staging),libraRunId,workspaceId,
  expectedWorkspaceRevision,expectedWorkspaceStateDigest,expectedReference{state(absent|present),revision,digest},
  workspaceMaterialHandle,episodeClaims,episodeScopeDigest,
  productVerificationRef(WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot)?,decisionDigest}`；`LibraWorkspaceMaterialReferenceResult@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,workspaceId,workspaceRevision,workspaceStateDigest,referenceSnapshot,
  workspaceMaterialReferenceSetDigest,resultDigest}`。Material Reference只是Libra business relation，文件bytes
  仍由Foundation Workspace handle定位；不得让`workspace_write` Capability暗写Libra Store。
  absent固定`revision=0,digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-reference-absent@1",workspaceId,
  materialHandleId}))`；present必须逐字节等于该reference stream最高revision。`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-reference-decision-id@1",operation,workspaceId,
  materialHandleId:workspaceMaterialHandle.handleId,expectedReferenceState:expectedReference.state,
  expectedReferenceRevision:expectedReference.revision,
  workspaceMaterialFenceDigest:workspaceMaterialHandle.fenceDigest}))`；该canonical object恰含上述7个顶层property，
  不嵌套Handle/expectedReference、不使用点号property name。Decision/Result digest均覆盖各自完整value excluding自身digest。
- `workspaceMaterialReferenceSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-reference-set@1",workspaceId,
  items:[每个referenceId最高revision且state!=released的完整Snapshot]按referenceId排序}))`；Workspace
  `stateDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-state@1",workspaceId,workspaceRevision,state,
  workspaceMaterialReferenceSetDigest,transitionKind,transitionEvidenceDigest}))`。Working→Product Staging只是一条
  append-only relation transition，不移动文件、不改变Material Identity，也不预先取得Deliverable Control。
  两种普通Reference operation都要求Run及Workspace仍active；Workspace一旦reclaiming只能由Cleanup Commit追加released。
  `attach_working`要求expected Reference absent且`productVerificationRef=NULL`；
  attach提交前还必须验证提交后的current non-released Reference总数不超过1024；
  `promote_to_product_staging`要求expected Reference current state=working并携带验证同一Handle且与目标Product
  Material role一致的完整`WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot@1`，同时完整Episode claims/scope digest必须逐字节沿用expected Reference。
  普通Reference事务不接受released目标；只有Cleanup Commit能在Deletion/already-absent
  Evidence成立后追加released revision。

**Product Package与Promotion：**

- `ProductStructureSnapshot@1`固定为
  `{structureKind(single|season),contentProfile,productScopeDigest,episodeScopeDigest,primaryMaterialCount,
  structuralDependencyCount,productStructureDigest}`；`productStructureDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  productStructureDigest))`。它只保存有界结构摘要，完整Material↔Episode N:M成员由
  Product Material Manifest承载，禁止在package row的structure JSON重复内联1024项列表。
- `ProductFactManifest@1`固定为`{manifestId,manifestRevision,libraRunId,items[1..256],factSetDigest,manifestDigest}`，items为
  `{productFactId,factKind,factRevision,schemaRef,factValue,factDigest,evidenceDigest,referenceDigest}`，按
  factKind/id/revision排序；`factValue`是对应immutable `libra_product_fact_revisions.fact_json`的完整typed value、
  单项≤`64 KiB`且必须重算相同`factDigest`；`referenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS(单项 excluding referenceDigest))`，
  `factSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-set@1",items}))`，manifest digest覆盖完整value excluding
  manifestDigest。`ArtifactManifest@1`固定为
  `{manifestId,manifestRevision,libraRunId,items[0..256],artifactSetDigest,manifestDigest}`，items为
  `{artifactHandleId,artifactKind,artifactRevision,artifactDigest,requirementDigest,materializationState,
  referenceDigest}`，按kind/handle/revision排序，单项reference digest同样排除自身，
  `artifactSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-artifact-set@1",items}))`，manifest digest覆盖完整value
  excluding自身。Resolved Identity与Media Cast必须分别是Product Fact Manifest内唯一
  `factKind=resolved_identity|media_cast`项；Package的两个对应Snapshot逐字节引用这些item并内联同一
  `factValue`，Media Cast Snapshot还必须从该value无损展开完整relations。
- Product Package内的`ProductionMaterialManifest@1`使用新`manifestId`且`libraRunId`相同；direct-original member
  从Run Material Manifest逐项复制Physical Reality/Binding并使用`assert_existing_input`；direct-carried Related
  从Run Basis Related Binding逐项复制并使用`assert_related_input`；Workspace member从current Product Staging
  Reference与Handle逐项复制并使用`acquire_workspace_product`。Product member额外包含
  `controlOperation,expectedControlRevision?,expectedControlProjectionDigest?,committedControlRevision,
  committedControlProjectionDigest`；member/set/manifest digest沿用本节公式且必须与Package relation rows逐字节相等。
- `OffloadContextManifest@1`固定为
  `{manifestId,manifestRevision,libraRunId,members[0..1024],memberSetDigest,manifestDigest}`；member是
  `{ordinal,materialKey,contextRole(original_input|structural_dependency|related_input),sourceRelatedReferenceId?,
  finalProductMaterialKey,dispositionKind(carried_forward|replaced_and_settled),physicalIdentity,location,
  bindingRevision,bindingEvidenceDigest,admittedControlRevision?,admittedControlProjectionDigest?,
  derivedAuthorityDigest?,settlementExpectation,memberDigest}`，按
  materialKey/contextRole排序；member digest覆盖单项excluding自身，set digest使用schema
  `libra.offload-context-members@1`，manifest digest覆盖完整value excluding自身。Primary/structural member必须带
  Control pair且不得带Related authority；related member必须逐项命中Run Basis Related Scope、携带source reference与
  derived authority且Control pair为NULL。每个Related恰好一row：同一materialKey direct carry使用
  `carried_forward+replace_or_move`，新successor使用`replaced_and_settled+remove_after_place`；不得遗漏、重复或以
  generic artifact替代。`settlementExpectation`只是`retain|replace_or_move|remove_after_place`的生产交接预期，
  不构成Arca Final Inventory Decision或删除授权。
  上述Product Fact、Artifact、Off-load Context与Product Material四个Manifest的`manifestRevision=packageRevision`；
  前三者的`manifestId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-submanifest-id@1",manifestKind(product_fact|artifact|offload_context),
  libraRunId,packageRevision}))`，Product Material沿用本节既有ID公式。四个ID/digest均写入Package row，不能只以
  relation所属package ID或aggregate digest冒充Manifest identity。
- `ProductionProvenance@1`固定为
  `{libraRunId,runExecutionBasisDigest,acceptanceSpecRecordDigest,workflowPlanRefs[0..256
  {planId,planRevision,planDigest}],productVerificationRefs[0..256 {verificationId,verificationDigest}],
  externalRealityObservationRefs[0..256 {evidenceId,evidenceDigest}],provenanceDigest}`；数组按ID排序且完整JCS≤`64 KiB`，
  只引用已持久化Plan/Evidence/Effect receipt，不内联日志；该字段只证明Libra读取过的外部现实，不授权或声称
  Libra修改Workspace之外的Physical Material。`LibraProductionAttestation@1`固定为
  `{attestationId,libraRunId,onDeckPackageId,acceptanceSpecId,acceptanceSpecRecordDigest,
  productConformanceEvidenceId,productConformanceEvidenceDigest,evaluatedRequirementSetDigest,
  productSnapshotDigest,unmetRequirementCount(0),attestedAtMs,attestationDigest}`；所有字段必须逐字节复制同Run、同Spec、
  `passed`的`ProductConformanceEvidence@1`，`attestationId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.production-attestation-id@1",libraRunId,onDeckPackageId,productConformanceEvidenceId,
  productConformanceEvidenceDigest}))`，`attestationDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding attestationDigest))`；只有
  unmet count为0且Conformance reason为空可发布。
- `LibraDeliverablePromotionDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,libraRunRef{libraRunId,stateRevision,stateDigest,executionBasisDigest,runScopeDigest,
  expectedPackageRevisionHead},runMaterialManifestRef{manifestId,manifestDigest},workspaceRef?{workspaceId,
  workspaceRevision,workspaceStateDigest},productStagingReferences[],acceptanceSpecRef{acceptanceSpecId,
  recordDigest},resolvedIdentitySnapshot,productStructureSnapshot,productFactManifest,artifactManifest,
  mediaCastSnapshot,productMaterialManifest,offloadContextManifest,productionProvenance,productionAttestation,
  relatedDispositionSetDigest,relatedAuthorityAssertions[0..1024],controlCommitScope{items[1..1024],controlScopeDigest},
  onDeckPackageId,packageRevision,packageDigest,offerId,
  decisionDigest}`。Product Staging refs按referenceId排序并与Workspace Product members恰好一一对应；每个ref的
  `WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot.verificationKind/materialRole`必须与matching Product Material member的role
  一致，媒体、Artifact与结构依赖分别使用各自closed分支；direct-original
  Package允许`workspaceRef=NULL/productStagingReferences=[]`；每个Workspace member的Episode claims聚合必须重算为
  matching Reference的`episodeScopeDigest`且完整claims逐字节相等，不能由caller另配Episode。Control item按materialKey排序，variant固定为
  `assert_existing_input{materialKey,expectedControlRevision,expectedControlProjectionDigest,
  ownerDomain:"libra",ownerScopeType:"subject",ownerScopeId:subjectId}`或
  `acquire_workspace_product{materialKey,expectedControlState:"absent",toOwnerDomain:"libra",
  toOwnerScopeType:"on_deck_package",toOwnerScopeId:onDeckPackageId}`；它与Product Manifest的controlOperation及
  matching `ResponsibilityControlCommitHandle`逐项相等。Related assertions按sourceRelatedReferenceId排序，逐项
  命中Run Basis `related_derived` Binding、Off-load mapping及Product member `assert_related_input`，不进入
  `ResponsibilityControlCommitHandle`或Control digest；其集合必须重算为`relatedDispositionSetDigest`且完整覆盖
  Run Basis Related Scope。`controlScopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.product-control-commit-scope@1",libraRunId,onDeckPackageId,items}))`。
- `relatedAuthorityAssertions`单项固定为
  `{sourceRelatedReferenceId,primaryMaterialKey,role,sourceMaterialKey,finalProductMaterialKey,
  associationEvidenceDigest,dispositionBasisDigest,bindingRevision,bindingEvidenceDigest,
  dispositionKind(carried_forward|replaced_and_settled),derivedAuthorityDigest,assertionDigest}`，按
  `sourceRelatedReferenceId`的UTF-8 bytes升序且唯一。`derivedAuthorityDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.related-derived-authority@1",subjectId,sourceRelatedReferenceId,primaryMaterialKey,role,
  sourceMaterialKey,associationEvidenceDigest,dispositionBasisDigest,bindingRevision,bindingEvidenceDigest}))`；
  `assertionDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整单项 excluding assertionDigest))`；`relatedDispositionSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.related-disposition-set@1",items:relatedAuthorityAssertions}))`。该Set必须逐项等于Run Basis frozen Related
  Scope、current immutable `related_derived` Binding、Off-load Context mapping及Product member
  `assert_related_input`的交集；Related direct carry固定`sourceMaterialKey=finalProductMaterialKey`，replacement固定两者
  不同。它证明dependent authority与source-to-final处置连续性，不创建或转移Material Control。
  `expectedPackageRevisionHead`固定为non-negative integer并逐字节等于`libra_runs.package_revision_head`当前数值；
  首个Package固定expected 0。`packageRevision=
  expectedPackageRevisionHead+1`，`onDeckPackageId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.on-deck-package-id@1",
  libraRunId,packageRevision}))`。该ID是在Control/Manifest构造前由Run内唯一revision确定性预派生的稳定身份，
  不是内容摘要、不是独立Reservation，也不得包含Product Manifest、Off-load Context、Package或Control digest；
  Commit仍必须CAS Run current `package_revision_head`，不得按MAX查询后盲插。
  `offerId`沿用8.5.11公式；`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.deliverable-promotion-decision-id@1",libraRunId,packageRevision,packageDigest,
  controlCommitScope.controlScopeDigest}))`。Decision digest覆盖完整typed input。
- `PBF-18`固定唯一的非循环构造顺序：先从expected head派生`packageRevision/onDeckPackageId`；再以该ID构造
  `on_deck_package`目标Control scope。`assert_existing_input` member的committed pair逐字节等于事务前已验证的
  current Control；`acquire_workspace_product` member固定形成revision 1，并按8.6.18从精确post-state
  `{controlled,ownerDomain:"libra",ownerScopeType:"on_deck_package",ownerScopeId:onDeckPackageId,
  regionProjection:"production"}`重算真实`committedControlProjectionDigest`。随后才把这些真实committed pair写入
  Product Material members并计算member/set/manifest digest，再计算Attestation、完整Package content digest、Offer与Decision。
  `PBF-18-R1`明确Package content digest覆盖8.6.19列出的完整nominal typed value，但排除两个自摘要字段以及
  只能由Promotion commit写入的`publishedAtMs`；提交后填入该时间不能改变Package/Offer identity，历史读取仍须从
  Owner rows重建完整Package并按相同排除规则复验digest。
  禁止使用`pending`、placeholder、预估或事后覆盖的Control digest；事务必须重算实际post-CAS Control row及同一marker
  historical revision，并与Decision/Product relation逐字节相等。`onDeckPackageId`负责稳定身份，`packageDigest`负责
  完整内容真实性；Handoff B始终以`onDeckPackageId+packageDigest`及逐成员historical Control projection验证交接，
  不把Package ID重新解释为内容摘要。Package head CAS、全部Control CAS/revision、Manifest/Package relation、
  Receipt/marker/Offer/Outbox全有或全无；失败CAS或rollback不得留下预派生ID对应的row或Control。
  Commit后assert member保留原Control revision/projection，acquire member固定形成revision 1；二者的post-state item按materialKey排序形成
  `controlRevisionSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-control-revision-set@1",onDeckPackageId,
  items:[{materialKey,controlOperation,committedControlRevision,committedControlProjectionDigest}]}))`，并进入Receipt。
- Promotion的durable Event Result是bounded `OnDeckProductPackageCommitReceipt@1`；完整
  `OnDeckProductPackage@1`是Libra-owned Handoff Deliverable，通过`ProductDeliveryPort`从关系表重建，不塞入
  `fx_event_result_bindings`的64 KiB JSON。Catalog中Receipt替换原来错误地把完整Package当作commit output的同一
  Result slot，故Result family计数不变。`LibraProductOfferAvailableMessage@1`固定为
  `{messageKind:"libra.product-offer.available@1",messageId,offerId,onDeckPackageId,packageRevision,packageDigest,
  libraRunId,subjectId,shelfId,acceptanceSpecId,relatedDispositionSetDigest,dedupKey}`；该digest逐字节等于Package与
  Off-load Context，允许Arca在不旁读Libra Store的情况下冻结dependent obligation；`messageId=dedupKey=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.product-offer-message-id@1",offerId,packageDigest}))`，consumer固定`ArcaAcceptanceFacade`。
- `ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1`固定为
  `{messageKind:"arca.product.accepted@1",messageId,offerId,onDeckPackageId,packageDigest,libraRunId,
  acceptanceDecisionId,acceptanceDecisionDigest,handoffReceipt{receiptId,custodyId,arcaBindingSetDigest,
  controlRevisionSetDigest,relatedDispositionSetDigest,receiptDigest},dedupKey}`；Related set只证明处置义务随Custody
  接收，不声明独立Control；`messageId=dedupKey=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "arca.product-accepted-message-id@1",offerId,acceptanceDecisionId,
  receiptDigest:handoffReceipt.receiptDigest}))`。该canonical object恰有`schema|offerId|acceptanceDecisionId|
  receiptDigest`四个顶层property；不嵌套`handoffReceipt`、不使用点号property name，也不覆盖Message其他字段。producer固定
  Arca Handoff B Accepted transaction，consumer固定Libra Run Lifecycle complete；完整message≤`16 KiB`。

**Discard、Cleanup admission与物理删除：**

- `LibraRunDiscardDecision@1`固定为
  `{discardDecisionId,libraRunId,expectedRunStateRevision,expectedRunStateDigest,runScopeDigest,
  originalInputControlScope{items[1..1024],scopeDigest},workspaceCleanupScopeDraft?,workspaceCleanupMemberSetDigest,
  actorId,idempotencyKey,
  decisionDigest}`；Control items逐项来自Run Material Manifest且按materialKey排序。`discardDecisionId=SHA-256(
  JCS({schema:"libra.run-discard-decision-id@1",libraRunId,actorId,idempotencyKey}))`；Decision/Receipt formula与
  8.5.11 row逐项对应。每个Control item固定为
  `{materialKey,expectedControlRevision,expectedControlProjectionDigest,fromOwnerDomain:"libra",
  fromOwnerScopeType:"subject",fromOwnerScopeId:subjectId,operation:"release"}`，必须逐项等于Run Material Manifest
  admitted Control snapshot及当前Foundation Control；`scopeDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.run-discard-input-control-scope@1",libraRunId,runScopeDigest,items}))`。匹配的
  `ResponsibilityControlCommitHandle`必须使用operationKind=`release`、同一basis/Control scope/expected revisions；
  committed release set按materialKey排序并进入Receipt，不得由current Subject Binding重新枚举。
  `LibraRunDiscardReceipt@1`固定为
  `{ReceiptEnvelope,discardDecisionId,libraRunId,committedRunStateRevision,releasedInputControlSetDigest,
  cleanupScopeId?,cleanupMemberSetDigest,commitDigest}`；固定`receiptKind=libra_run_discarded,ownerDomain=libra,
  scopeType=libra_run,scopeId=libraRunId,scopeDigest=LibraRunDiscardDecision.decisionDigest`，
  `receiptId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-discard-receipt-id@1",discardDecisionId}))`，
  `commitDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding commitDigest))`；scope nullable规则与表一致。
  `LibraWorkspaceCleanupRequestedMessage@1`固定为
  `{messageKind:"libra.workspace-cleanup.requested@1",messageId,libraRunId,cleanupScopeId?,
  cleanupMemberSetDigest,triggerDigest,dedupKey}`，`messageId=dedupKey=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-message-id@1",libraRunId,triggerDigest,cleanupMemberSetDigest}))`，consumer固定Libra
  Workspace Reclaimer；它只wake，非空Scope本身已在Discard事务成立。
- `OffloadCompletionQuery@1`固定为`{queryContract:"arca.offload-completion@1",onDeckPackageId,
  expectedPackageDigest}`；`OffloadCompletionReadResult@1`为`found{projectionRevision(1),projectionDigest,
  onDeckPackageId,packageDigest,offloadCompletionFact}`或`not_found{checkedAtMs}`。found的package pair必须逐字节等于
  Query；`projectionDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"arca.offload-completion-projection@1",projectionRevision:1,
  offloadCompletionFact}))`，从immutable `arca_offload_completions` row确定性重建，不要求第二张Projection表；
  不一致是integrity error。Arca `OffloadCompletionPort`只读Owner Fact/Projection，不触发
  On-deck；found历史revision可重放。Libra只把found variant作为offload cleanup trigger，not_found不是失败也不
  建Scope。
- `WorkspaceCleanupScopeAdmissionDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,triggerKind(offload_completed|run_superseded|run_discarded),triggerSnapshot,
  libraRunRef{libraRunId,stateRevision,stateDigest,executionBasisDigest},
  workspaceRef{workspaceId,workspaceRevision,workspaceStateDigest,materialReferenceSetDigest},
  graceDeadlineMs,referenceAudit?{observation1,observation2},eligibilityEvidenceDigest,
  members[0..1024],memberSetDigest,cleanupScopeId,
  decisionDigest}`。`triggerSnapshot`是closed union：offload固定为完整found
  `OffloadCompletionReadResult@1`；superseded固定为`{oldRunRef,replacementRunRef}`且两项互相引用同一replacement；
  discard固定为`{discardDecisionId,expectedFrozenRunRevision,expectedFrozenRunDigest}`，不得内联尚未计算的父
  `discardDecisionDigest`形成自引用。
  offload与superseded variant的两次observation必须间隔至少一个Reclaimer周期、都证明无其他
  active Libra Reference；offload还要求当前时间不早于Completion后24小时，superseded要求replacement Run已成立且
  grace为0；discard variant由Discard事务直接形成且grace为0。superseded trigger固定
  `triggerRef=oldLibraRunId,triggerRevision=terminalStateRevision,triggerDigest=terminalStateDigest`，只清理旧Run Workspace，
  不接管或删除replacement Workspace；它关闭旧Run未被Arca Accepted的Workspace/Product遗留责任。offload固定
  `triggerRef=offloadCompletionFact.factId,triggerRevision=projectionRevision,
  triggerDigest=projectionDigest`；discard固定`triggerRef=discardDecisionId,triggerRevision=1,
  triggerDigest=discardDecisionDigest`。三种映射不得由Store实现自行选择Fact digest或时间戳替代。
  offload的`graceDeadlineMs=offloadCompletionFact.committedAtMs+86_400_000`，superseded/discard固定0；时间计算溢出或
  Completion缺commit time稳定拒绝。
  每个reference observation固定为`{observedAtMs,activeReferenceSetDigest,activeReferenceCount,
  controlProjectionSetDigest,evidenceDigest}`；其中active set只枚举目标Workspace之外、仍引用任一目标materialKey/handle的
  current Libra Reference，合格observation必须`activeReferenceCount=0`且digest为正式empty set；Control set则完整
  枚举目标members的完整available Control Projection（包括uncontrolled、Libra-owned和other-owned）。Admission事务必须从current Reference/Control rows重算并逐字节等于
  第二次observation，变化即stale且不建Scope。discard variant的`referenceAudit=NULL`，其他variant必须非NULL且第二次时间更晚。
  `activeReferenceSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-other-reference-set@1",
  targetWorkspaceId:workspaceRef.workspaceId,items:[{workspaceId,referenceId,referenceRevision,referenceDigest}]
  按workspaceId/referenceId排序}))`，空集也使用该公式；
  `controlProjectionSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-control-projection-set@1",
  items:[{materialKey,controlDisposition,controlRevision,controlProjectionDigest,ownerDomain?,ownerScopeType?,
  ownerScopeId?}]按materialKey排序}))`；从未存在Control row以revision 0/uncontrolled正式表达，不能省略该item；
  observation的`evidenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整observation excluding evidenceDigest))`。
  `eligibilityEvidenceDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-eligibility@1",triggerKind,
  triggerSnapshot,libraRunRef,workspaceRef,graceDeadlineMs,referenceAudit}))`；它不覆盖members，成员由独立set digest约束。
  offload与superseded variant的`cleanupScopeId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-scope-id@1",triggerKind,
  triggerRef,triggerRevision,triggerDigest,workspaceId}))`；discard variant固定为`SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-scope-id@1",triggerKind,discardDecisionId,workspaceId}))`，其row在Decision完成后保存
  `triggerDigest=discardDecisionDigest`，Decision本身不得把该自digest回填为输入。
  member为`{materialHandleId,materialKey,workspaceReferenceId,
  expectedReferenceRevision,expectedReferenceDigest,
  controlDisposition(uncontrolled|libra_owned|other_owned),expectedControlRevision,
  expectedControlProjectionDigest,expectedControlOwnerDomain?,expectedControlOwnerScopeType?,
  expectedControlOwnerScopeId?,cleanupKind:"delete_or_verify_absent",memberDigest}`，按handle ID排序；
  Control字段必须逐字节映射current `MaterialControlProjectionSnapshot@1`：uncontrolled无owner、libra_owned的owner
  domain固定libra、other_owned固定为非libra；Cleanup只能释放libra_owned Control。
  members必须恰好覆盖该Workspace每个reference stream最高revision中`state!=released`的handle，不得漏项、重复或
  把历史released revision重新纳入；`created`要求`1..1024`项，没有此类成员时Decision固定为空数组并且只允许typed
  `no_op`，不能建立空Scope。
  `memberDigest=SHA-256(JCS(member excluding memberDigest))`；`memberSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-members@1",items:members}))`；offload/superseded admission的`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-admission-decision-id@1",triggerRef,triggerRevision,triggerDigest,workspaceId,
  memberSetDigest}))`；discard draft的`decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-admission-decision-id@1",triggerKind:"run_discarded",discardDecisionId,workspaceId,
  memberSetDigest}))`。
  `WorkspaceCleanupScopeAdmissionResult@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,resultKind(created|no_op),cleanupScopeId?,scopeStateRevision?,scopeStateDigest?,memberSetDigest,
  memberCount,committedWorkspaceRevision?,committedWorkspaceStateDigest?,resultDigest}`。created固定
  `scopeStateRevision=1`且Workspace双字段非NULL、为reclaiming post-state，no_op要求这些字段全部NULL。offload或superseded没有Workspace Reference时返回semantic no-op且
  不建Scope；discard的同类空结果只由Discard Receipt的nullable scope ref与正式empty member-set digest表达，不另写
  Scope Admission Result。
  `WorkspaceCleanupScopeAdmissionRecord@1`等于Decision除`members`外的全部字段，并增加
  `memberCount/memberSetDigest`；Scope row保存该Record，member rows保存完整members。历史重建必须合并两者并重算
  `decisionDigest`；不得把只有trigger/eligibility摘要的row称为完整Decision。
- `WorkspaceCleanupEffectIntent@1`固定为
  `{intentId,cleanupScopeId,workspaceId,materialHandleId,expectedWorkspaceHandleDigest,expectedReferenceRevision,
  expectedReferenceDigest,controlFence{controlDisposition,expectedControlRevision,
  expectedControlProjectionDigest,expectedControlOwnerDomain?,expectedControlOwnerScopeType?,
  expectedControlOwnerScopeId?},effectMode(delete_or_verify_absent|verify_absent_only),containmentFenceDigest,
  idempotencyKey,intentDigest}`；只授权处理一个Workspace-contained handle，不携带父目录或Material Field/Shelf target路径。
  uncontrolled/libra_owned固定`delete_or_verify_absent`，other_owned固定`verify_absent_only`且文件仍存在时必须返回
  control conflict、不得调用delete。`intentId=idempotencyKey=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
  "libra.workspace-cleanup-effect-intent-id@1",cleanupScopeId,workspaceId,materialHandleId,
  expectedReferenceRevision,expectedReferenceDigest,controlFence,effectMode}))`，`intentDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding
  intentDigest))`；同一member retry必须复用相同Intent/Effect idempotency key。
- `WorkspaceMaterialDeletionEvidence@1`固定为
  `{EvidenceEnvelope,effectId,cleanupScopeId,materialHandleId,preDeleteHandleDigest,result(deleted|already_absent),
  postDeleteContainmentProbeDigest,effectReceiptId,evidenceDigest}`；只能由既有幂等filesystem delete effect产生，
  `already_absent`也必须证明目标恰是Workspace-contained handle，不能以父目录扫描代替。Effect成功必须以同一
  receipt把`fx_workspace_materials`从active CAS为reclaimed；Evidence的effect/receipt digest与该terminal row逐字节
  相等，Domain Commit只消费Evidence而不重做物理效果。`other_owned` Intent不得产生`deleted`结果；文件仍存在时
  只能返回control conflict，只有确证already absent才能形成本Evidence。
- `WorkspaceCleanupBlockingEvidence@1`固定为
  `{EvidenceEnvelope,cleanupScopeId,materialHandleId,terminalFailureCode(workspace_path_escaped|identity_mismatch|
  control_conflict|effect_retry_exhausted),lastEffectId?,lastEffectFailureDigest?,observedFenceDigest,evidenceDigest}`；只在
  有界Effect retry耗尽或安全Fence确定冲突后形成，不能把暂时资源等待、可重试I/O或Provider失败标成blocked。
- `WorkspaceCleanupCommitDecision@1`固定为
  `{decisionId,cleanupScopeId,expectedScopeStateRevision,expectedScopeStateDigest,workspaceId,
  expectedWorkspaceRevision,expectedWorkspaceStateDigest,materialHandleId,expectedReferenceRevision,
  expectedReferenceDigest,expectedMemberStateRevision,expectedMemberStateDigest,outcome{kind(deletion_verified|
  terminal_blocked),deletionEvidence?,blockingEvidence?},
  expectedControlFence{materialKey,controlDisposition,revision,projectionDigest,ownerDomain?,ownerScopeType?,
  ownerScopeId?},decisionDigest}`。
  `decisionId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-commit-decision-id@1",cleanupScopeId,
  materialHandleId,expectedMemberStateRevision,outcomeEvidenceDigest}))`，其中outcomeEvidenceDigest从互斥variant
  唯一取得；Decision digest覆盖完整value，expected Workspace必须处于reclaiming。deletion_verified要求Deletion Evidence且禁止Blocking Evidence；
  terminal_blocked反之。Control fence必须逐字节等于Scope member及current Projection；libra_owned completed
  member在同事务release，uncontrolled不写Control revision，other_owned不释放且只接受`already_absent` Evidence。
  任一Control Projection变化使Decision stale并重新评估Scope，不能在省略release或越权删除的情况下提交。Result使用
  `WorkspaceCleanupCommitReceipt@1`；`cleanupState=completed`表示本member完成，scope是否完成由同事务重算全部
  member terminal state后决定；blocked只终结本member/Scope并保留Reference与Control供人工诊断；完成member必须在同事务追加对应Reference `released` revision，全部member
  completed时再把Libra Workspace与Foundation Registry置为reclaimed。Deletion Effect成功但commit前崩溃时复用相同effect receipt；commit成功后重放
  原Receipt，不再次删除或释放Control。`deletionEvidence.preDeleteHandleDigest`必须逐字节等于expected Reference
  冻结的`workspaceHandleDigest`，Evidence中的scope/handle也必须等于Decision；否则拒绝提交。
  completed非末项追加一条Workspace `state=reclaiming,transitionKind=reference_released` revision；末项追加一条
  `state=reclaimed,transitionKind=reclaimed` revision并让同事务Reference的`committedWorkspaceRevision`指向它，
  不为同一member虚构两条Workspace revision。blocked不追加Workspace/Reference revision。

Cleanup member的`stateDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-member-state@1",cleanupScopeId,
materialHandleId,stateRevision,state,outcomeEvidenceDigest,cleanupReceiptId,committedControlRevision?}))`；Scope的
`stateDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-scope-state@1",cleanupScopeId,stateRevision,state,
memberSetDigest,terminalMemberSetDigest,completedAtMs?}))`，terminal member set按materialHandleId排序。每次member
commit都使Scope state revision加1；blocked member使Scope为blocked，只有全部completed才为completed。

`ProductDeliveryQuery@1`固定为`{queryContract:"libra.product-delivery@1",readPurpose(historical|
acceptance_fence),offerId,onDeckPackageId,expectedPackageRevision,expectedPackageDigest}`；
`ProductDeliveryPort.readPackage(ProductDeliveryQuery@1)`必须返回
`ProductDeliveryReadResult@1(found{onDeckProductPackage,readDigest}|not_found{reasonCode(package_missing),
checkedAtMs})`；found还携带`deliveryFence?{eligibility(eligible|ineligible),reasonCode?,libraRunId,
runState,runStateRevision,runStateDigest,acceptanceSpecId,packageRevisionHead,deliveryReceiptAbsent,
productControlSetDigest?,fenceDigest}`。historical固定Fence为NULL；acceptance_fence只有Run仍active、Spec/Package
current、尚无Delivery Receipt且Package Product/Off-load去重Control仍由Libra持有时为eligible；否则reason固定为
`run_not_active|spec_not_current|package_not_current|delivery_already_terminal|control_not_libra`并返回ineligible，Arca不得
Accepted。Offer或digest不一致
是contract integrity error而不是not_found。found的`readDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
"libra.product-delivery-read@1",query,onDeckProductPackage.packageDigest,deliveryFence}))`并携带完整`OnDeckProductPackage@1`，历史Package在Offer/Run
终结后仍可由Package、relation、Run Material Manifest和immutable Product Fact rows重建。

`WorkspaceCleanupScopeQuery@1`固定为
`{queryContract:"libra.workspace-reclamation.scope@1",cleanupScopeId,readSelector{kind(current|revision),
revision?},expectedCurrent?{stateRevision,stateDigest},queryId,queryDigest}`。`revision` selector要求revision为正整数且
`expectedCurrent=NULL`；`current` selector要求revision为NULL，`expectedCurrent`可以整体缺省，但一旦存在必须同时
携带revision与digest。`queryId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-scope-query-id@1",
cleanupScopeId,readSelector,expectedCurrent?}))`；`queryDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding queryDigest))`。
该Query不允许以Run、Workspace、路径、Material或时间范围替代唯一`cleanupScopeId`。

`WorkspaceCleanupScopeProjection@1`固定为
`{cleanupScopeId,libraRunId,triggerKind,state,stateRevision,stateDigest,memberCount,pendingCount,completedCount,
blockedCount,memberSetDigest,terminalMemberStateSetDigest,createdAtMs,completedAtMs?,projectionDigest}`。
`memberCount`来自Admission冻结member set；目标revision为1时三个terminal计数为0，此后按
`committed_scope_state_revision<=目标revision`的member terminal row重建，且
`pendingCount+completedCount+blockedCount=memberCount`。`terminalMemberStateSetDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:
"libra.workspace-cleanup-terminal-member-states@1",cleanupScopeId,scopeStateRevision:目标revision,
items:[{committedScopeStateRevision,stateRevision,state,stateDigest}]按committedScopeStateRevision升序}))`；空集也使用
同一公式。`projectionDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding projectionDigest))`。Projection只给出聚合进度，
不得展开Material、Handle、Reference、Control owner或路径；目标revision尚未completed时`completedAtMs=NULL`，不能
从later current Scope回填未来完成时间。

`WorkspaceCleanupScopeReadResult@1`固定为closed union：

- `found{queryId,queryDigest,projection,resultDigest}`；
- `not_found{queryId,queryDigest,reasonCode(scope_missing|revision_missing),resultDigest}`；
- `stale{queryId,queryDigest,expectedStateRevision,expectedStateDigest,actualStateRevision,actualStateDigest,
  resultDigest}`；
- `integrity_error{queryId,queryDigest,reasonCode(owner_rows_incomplete|revision_chain_broken|digest_mismatch|
  discard_receipt_continuity_broken),resultDigest}`。

每个`resultDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.workspace-cleanup-scope-read-result@1",完整variant excluding
resultDigest}))`。`readSelector=current`携带`expectedCurrent`且current pair不相等时只返回`stale`；未携带时返回提交
瞬间的current Projection。`readSelector=revision`只读取该immutable revision，不因为current后来推进而stale。
历史revision 1由Scope Admission row及完整member set恢复；revision N>1由唯一
`committed_scope_state_revision=2..N`的member terminal rows顺序恢复，并逐revision重算Scope state digest。
任何缺号、重复号、member/state digest不一致或run-discard trigger无法连接同一
`libra_run_discard_receipts`时只返回`integrity_error`，不得返回部分Projection。

`LibraRunDiscardCommand@1`固定为
`{commandContract:"libra.run-discard@1",commandId,libraRunId,expectedRunStateRevision,
expectedRunStateDigest,actorId,idempotencyKey,commandDigest}`；
`commandId=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-discard-decision-id@1",libraRunId,actorId,idempotencyKey}))`并逐字节
等于既有`discardDecisionId`，`commandDigest=SHA-256(JCS(完整value excluding commandDigest))`。
Command不得携带Control member、Workspace member、Material、路径或删除参数；`LibraRunDiscardCoordinator`必须从
immutable Run Material Manifest、current frozen Run revision及current Workspace Reference重建完整
`LibraRunDiscardDecision@1`并调用既有Run Discard canonical transaction。

`LibraRunDiscardCommandResult@1`固定为closed union：

- `discarded{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,discardReceipt:LibraRunDiscardReceipt@1,
  cleanupMemberCount,resultDigest}`；
- `not_found{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,reasonCode(run_missing),resultDigest}`；
- `stale{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,expectedRunStateRevision,expectedRunStateDigest,
  actualRunStateRevision,actualRunStateDigest,resultDigest}`；
- `invalid_state{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,reasonCode(run_not_frozen),actualRunStateRevision,
  actualRunStateDigest,resultDigest}`；
- `conflict{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,reasonCode(idempotency_key_reused),existingCommandDigest,
  resultDigest}`；
- `integrity_error{commandId,commandDigest,libraRunId,reasonCode(run_history_incomplete|
  material_manifest_incomplete|workspace_reference_incomplete|control_fence_mismatch|discard_receipt_mismatch),
  resultDigest}`。

每个`resultDigest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.run-discard-command-result@1",完整variant excluding resultDigest}))`。
同一`actorId+idempotencyKey`成功重放必须从`libra_run_discard_decisions/receipts`、对应Run revision、原始Input
Control revision及可选Cleanup Scope/member rows重建并逐字节返回同一`discarded` Result，不增加“replayed”业务variant，
不重新释放Control或建立Scope。`cleanupMemberCount=0`时Receipt的`cleanupScopeId=NULL`且member set为正式empty digest；
非零时必须等于同一Scope relation数量。失败variant不伪造Receipt；integrity失败不得回读Foundation Event Result、
caller cache、当前目录Reality或另一Domain Store补齐。

两个方法的outcome precedence固定：Scope Query先验证Query形状，再判断scope/revision存在性，再完整重建并校验
Owner history，随后才比较可选expected current pair，依次得到`not_found|integrity_error|stale|found`；Discard先按
`actorId+idempotencyKey`检查同一Decision semantic replay或key冲突，再判断Run存在性，再重建并校验Owner history，
随后比较expected pair与`frozen` state，最后才提交，依次得到`discarded|conflict|not_found|integrity_error|stale|
invalid_state|discarded`。格式/enum/上限不合法是contract validation error，不伪装成业务Result。

`WorkspaceReclamationPort`的正式callable contract因此只有
`readCleanupScope(WorkspaceCleanupScopeQuery@1) -> WorkspaceCleanupScopeReadResult@1`与
`discardFrozenRun(LibraRunDiscardCommand@1) -> LibraRunDiscardCommandResult@1`。这些Application/Facade DTO不属于
Catalog Capability input/output，不新增Capability或Catalog Result family；Query无副作用，Command只进入既有Run
Discard事务，不能直接调用Workspace deletion effect。
以上DTO的任何relation缺失、digest不一致或current CAS改变都是integrity/stale result，不允许从Foundation Event
Result、caller cache、当前目录Reality或另一Domain Store补值。

PBF-13相关Canonical Transaction的机器表集固定如下；`Result/marker`分别指
`fx_event_result_bindings/fx_commit_markers`，不得因某个variant没有row而从transaction manifest删表：

| Transaction | Exact write tables | Additional exact fence/read tables | Outbox |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Run Admission | `libra_run_admission_heads,libra_runs,libra_run_revisions,libra_run_material_manifests,libra_run_material_members,libra_run_material_episode_claims` + Result/marker | `libra_subjects,libra_subject_decision_heads,libra_acceptance_specs,libra_material_bindings,libra_material_binding_episode_claims,fx_material_controls,fx_material_control_revisions`及全部write tables | no |

`PBF-14`把既有Domain Fact Commit的三个Product Fact variants固定为下述可抽取machine contract；它们属于同一个
已计数Canonical Transaction，不新增第44项。表中逗号分隔的table set均为exact complete set，不是additional set；
`participants`、`writeTables`、`readTables`、`fenceContract`和`rollbackInvariant`逐项物化进对应variant：

~~~text
CanonicalTransactionVariantOverride@1 {
  variantId
  selector {
    selectorKind: domain_fact_handle_exact
    factType
    factSchemaRef
    resultSchemaRef
  }
  participants[]
  writeTables[]
  readTables[]
  dynamicTableRequirements[]
  fenceContract {
    domainRevisionFenceRequired
    materialControlCasRequired
    commitMarkerRequired
    outboxRequired
  }
  rollbackInvariant
  crashFixtureRefs[]
}
~~~

数组按`variantId` UTF-8 bytes升序物化；selector三个value均为required exact string且同一父事务内不得重复。
`selectorKind`只允许上述closed value；未来增加其他selector kind必须升级该nominal schema，不能把任意表达式或函数塞入
Registry。

| Parent transaction | variantId | Exact selector | Exact participants / writeTables | Exact readTables | Exact fenceContract | Exact rollbackInvariant | Exact crashFixtureRefs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `helix.transaction.domain-fact-commit@1` | `libra_media_cast_fact@1` | `DomainFactCommitHandle.factType=media_cast; factSchemaRef=MediaCastFact@1; resultSchemaRef=MediaCastFact@1` | `domain(owner=libra,access=write,tables=[libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs]); foundation(owner=execution-foundation,access=write,tables=[fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers])`；`writeTables=[libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers]`；`dynamicTableRequirements=[]` | `[libra_runs,libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_supporting_works,fx_work_attempts,fx_workflow_plans,fx_plan_nodes,fx_workflow_events,fx_event_attempts,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers]`；同`factKind`历史rows用于revision fence；closed Source Basis为Metadata Observation或Western Match；Event Attempt用于核对实际执行input snapshot，不得只凭Plan binding猜测 | `{domainRevisionFenceRequired:true,materialControlCasRequired:false,commitMarkerRequired:true,outboxRequired:false}` | `Fact revision、全部Source refs、durable typed Result与commit marker全有或全无；任何selector、Run/revision/source-basis/Result/schema/digest/fence失败时零写入可见，且不得存在fx_outbox row` | `[Libra Product Fact Commit variants]` |
| `helix.transaction.domain-fact-commit@1` | `libra_product_metadata_fact@1` | `DomainFactCommitHandle.factType=product_metadata; factSchemaRef=ProductMetadataFact@1; resultSchemaRef=ProductMetadataFact@1` | `domain(owner=libra,access=write,tables=[libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs]); foundation(owner=execution-foundation,access=write,tables=[fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers])`；`writeTables=[libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers]`；`dynamicTableRequirements=[]` | `[libra_runs,libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_supporting_works,fx_work_attempts,fx_workflow_plans,fx_plan_nodes,fx_workflow_events,fx_event_attempts,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers,fx_artifact_registry]`；同Run Media Cast Fact、Artifact Handle、Verify Event实际input snapshot在事务内验证；closed Source Basis为Metadata Observation或Western Analysis+Normalize | `{domainRevisionFenceRequired:true,materialControlCasRequired:false,commitMarkerRequired:true,outboxRequired:false}` | `Fact revision、全部Source refs、Artifact fence、durable typed Result与commit marker全有或全无；任何selector、Run/revision/source-basis/Artifact/Result/schema/digest/fence失败时零写入可见，且不得存在fx_outbox row` | `[Libra Product Fact Commit variants]` |
| `helix.transaction.domain-fact-commit@1` | `libra_resolved_identity_fact@1` | `DomainFactCommitHandle.factType=resolved_identity; factSchemaRef=ResolvedProductIdentity@1; resultSchemaRef=ResolvedProductIdentity@1` | `domain(owner=libra,access=write,tables=[libra_subjects,libra_product_identity_revisions,libra_subject_season_continuity_claims,libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs]); foundation(owner=execution-foundation,access=write,tables=[fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers])`；`writeTables=[libra_subjects,libra_product_identity_revisions,libra_subject_season_continuity_claims,libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers]`；`dynamicTableRequirements=[]` | `[libra_runs,libra_subjects,libra_product_identity_revisions,libra_subject_season_continuity_claims,libra_product_fact_revisions,libra_product_fact_source_refs,fx_supporting_works,fx_work_attempts,fx_workflow_plans,fx_plan_nodes,fx_workflow_events,fx_event_attempts,fx_event_result_bindings,fx_commit_markers]`；Subject pointer与Run/fact revision均在事务内重验；closed Source Basis为Product Identity Resolution的Decision Evidence Result链；Event Attempt用于核对实际执行input snapshot | `{domainRevisionFenceRequired:true,materialControlCasRequired:false,commitMarkerRequired:true,outboxRequired:false}` | `Run Product Fact、Subject Identity revision/current pointer、全部exact continuity claims、Source refs、durable typed Result与commit marker全有或全无；任何selector、Run/Subject/revision/source-basis/Result/schema/digest/fence失败时零写入可见，且不得存在fx_outbox row` | `[Libra Product Fact Commit variants]` |

三个variant写入Source refs前必须按discriminator从Decision Evidence完整重建Identity Resolution链、从Selection完整重建Observation Set，或从Western Basis完整重建
Analysis→Normalize / Match链，并逐项重验Work→Attempt→Plan→Event→Result；
Product Metadata variant还必须从Commit Payload/Owner row内完整`VerifiedArtifactManifest`取得去重后的显式
`verificationResultRef`集合，逐项读取对应Work→Plan→Event→`ArtifactManifestVerification@1`，验证Plan input中的完整
Handle/Requirement、Result passed item和`fx_artifact_registry` row；`requirementDigest`必须命中同一
`ProductMetadataDraft.artifactRequirements`成员。`fx_event_result_bindings`同时是Source Basis/Artifact Verification的
read table与当前Commit Result的write table，Coordinator必须按不同`result_id/event_id`区分，不允许覆盖既有Result。
同一variant还必须按Commit Payload的nullable`mediaCastFactRef`执行精确ID读取或精确NULL传播；非NULL Fact必须由同一
`libra_product_fact_revisions` Owner row重建完整`MediaCastFact@1`并重算Fact digest，不能按Run扫描“最新”Media Cast。
任一引用缺失、schema/digest不匹配、revision fence变化或typed Result/Manifest无法由Owner row重建，都使整个
transaction rollback；Product Fact仍引用相关Result期间，Result链与Artifact Registry row不得GC。

`offload_completed`查询结果作为typed immutable input进入Cleanup Scope Admission，不把`arca_*`加入Libra事务
read set；如果该Workspace没有任何未released Reference，Reclaimer返回typed semantic no-op并不建立空Scope。
上述当前variant要求的write row、Control revision、Result、marker或required Outbox缺失都使事务整体回滚；
semantic replay先从Owner rows重建原Decision/Result并校验digest，再返回原结果，不能重新分配ID或重复外部效果。
Cleanup Scope Admission的`no_op`是唯一没有新Owner业务Fact的variant，只从同事务Result/marker重放；这不是以
Foundation Result补读Owner事实。事务manifest列出的variant-superset表不要求无关variant伪造空row。

### 8.7 依赖方向、Fact Owner与静态架构护栏

#### 8.7.1 允许的依赖矩阵

| Caller package | May depend on | Must not depend on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `composition/` | 所有Domain public、Foundation public、Integration implementation、Persistence Kernel | Domain internal implementation被再次导出给外部 |
| 一个Domain `public/` | 本Domain application/model、公开contracts | 另一Domain internal、Repository、Executor |
| 一个Domain `application/` | 本Domain model/persistence port/planning port、Foundation public、注入的其他Domain public query/handoff port | 另一Domain Store、Integration implementation、Foundation Repository |
| 一个Domain `planning/` | 本Domain model、自己的Catalog view、pure graph/schema library | Provider call、Store、Resource Governor、另一个Domain Planner |
| 一个Domain `capabilities/` | 当前Capability contract、typed ExecutionContext、注入的Integration port、底层pure library | 任意Facade、Work creator、Planner、Store、另一个Executor |
| `foundation/` | `contracts/`、Foundation Repository ports、owner-neutral infrastructure | 任一Domain implementation、Shelf/Spec/Perception业务规则 |
| `integrations/` | Integration contracts、protocol/filesystem/FFmpeg libraries | Domain Store、Business Process、Workflow decision |
| `projections/` | Domain public batch Query、Foundation read-only diagnostics | Domain Store写入、Capability、Business commit |
| HTTP adapter | Application Facade、read-only Projection | Domain Store、Planner、Runtime、Capability Registry |

Domain A可以import Domain B的`public/index.js`，但只能取得已经登记的Query/Resolution或Handoff port；不能
借public入口返回“通用execute”“raw data”“getStore”或可变Domain对象规避依赖规则。

#### 8.7.2 Fact Owner到Repository唯一映射

| Canonical fact family | Sole writer | Physical Repository |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Material Field、Field Observation、Extraction、Candidate | Procurement | Procurement repositories |
| Subject、Routing、Decision Basis、Acceptance Spec、Libra Run、Product Package | Libra | Libra repositories |
| Shelf、Standard、Acceptance、Inventory、Shelf Entry、Deck Fact、Care、Off-deck | Arca | Arca repositories |
| Perception Record/Resolution | User Perception | Perception repositories |
| Person Registry/Preference/Reference | People Management | People repository |
| Work/Plan/Event/Attempt/Effect technical facts | Execution Foundation | Foundation repositories |
| Material Control uniqueness | Material Control Authority | `fx_material_control*` repositories |
| Integration/Workspace/Resource/Worker/Admin Credential technical settings | Platform settings | `platform_*` repositories |
| UI/diagnostic projection | Projection Builder | `read_*` only; never canonical |

同一个Domain内也不允许一个Repository写另一聚合的表来“省一次调用”。跨Aggregate atomic commit通过
Domain-owned Unit of Work和typed Commit Participant完成，不通过Repository互相调用。

#### 8.7.3 Domain-local Binding严格隔离

Procurement、Libra和Arca分别拥有自己的Material Binding表与typed Repository：

~~~text
proc_* binding  → Field Material / Candidate context
libra_* binding → Subject / Production input / Product context
arca_* binding  → On-deck Custody / Inventory Representation
~~~

Handoff transfer可以依据immutable Manifest和Acceptance Decision在接收Domain建立新Binding，但不能移动、
复用或继续更新上游Binding row。Material Control Registry只记录Identity当前控制Domain/Scope，不保存路径
或充当全局Binding。

#### 8.7.4 架构静态测试是build门禁

Level 8实现必须提供独立静态审计测试，至少检查：

1. 只有Composition Root同时import五个Domain public package和Foundation construction API；
2. Domain之间没有internal path或Repository import；
3. Foundation没有Domain implementation import；
4. Capability Executor源码不能importPlanner、Work Submission、Repository、Application Facade或另一个
   Capability Executor；
5. Planner源码不能importIntegration implementation、filesystem、FFmpeg、Store或Resource Governor；
6. Runtime dispatch只使用`capabilityRef@version`，不存在classification/flowKind/executor-name映射；
7. 每个Store write方法都登记Canonical Owner与表前缀，跨Owner写入为零；
8. HTTP GET/Projection没有Command、Reconcile或Store write依赖；
9. `Nexora`、旧Gate Task、Membership、Admission、maintenanceComplete和complex Executor不在clean runtime；
10. 只有一个SQLite Kernel和一个Resource Governor construction path。

静态审计允许历史归档、cutover负向测试和旧代码删除清单出现禁词，但clean runtime、public contract和新测试
不能豁免。豁免必须按文件和原因显式登记，不能使用目录级allow-list。

#### 8.7.5 Dynamic contract测试补充静态审计

必须通过contract tests证明：

- Domain public Facade返回immutable DTO/Projection，不泄露内部对象或Store；
- Capability schema、Effect Class、Resource Demand、Fence和Result绑定匹配；
- Handoff Accepted事务不存在接收方事实成立但Control未转移，或Control已转移但接收方责任Fact缺失；
- duplicate Signal、Receipt和Effect Reconcile幂等；
- read model删除后可以从Canonical Facts重建；
- 同一Physical Material Identity不能形成双Control；
- old Plan/version不可静默绑定新Executor；
- bulk Query在50项和200项规模下保持有界SQL数量，不发生按项跨Domain调用。

具体性能阈值和测试环境属于Level 10；这些正确性不变量在Level 8即为立即失败条件。

### 8.8 现有实现的clean-cut物理映射

#### 8.8.1 Cutover原则

现有`media-service/src`是历史Kairox/早期Helix实现地图，不是可逐步修补的clean骨架。实施时采用新
`src/helix/`根目录并从Composition Root切换；旧Runtime不得与clean Runtime双跑、双写、双读或按媒体
类型分流。

旧代码可以提供三类Evidence：

- 底层算法/协议已经可行；
- 历史安全边界与失败模式；
- 能力守恒测试样本。

旧代码不能提供Canonical Owner、Store、Task/Gate语义或依赖方向的默认继承权。

#### 8.8.2 现有模块处置矩阵

| Current implementation area | Clean disposition | Reason / target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `libraCompositionRoot.js` | replace | 改为唯一`helix/composition/createHelixApplication`；旧root只装配Nexora/Kairox且含业务Signal判断 |
| `libraService.js`、`libraRuntime.js`、`libraReconciler.js` | decompose and rewrite | Intake、Decision Preparation、Routing/Spec、Run、Workspace和Delivery分别进入Libra组件；不保留Membership/phase/admission模型 |
| `nexoraService.js`、`nexoraStore.js`、observation engine | remove old module; salvage algorithms | Field observation/Triage进Procurement；正式Off-load/Settlement进Arca；不保留Nexora Facade或Store |
| `kairoxService.js`、`kairoxRuntime.js`、admission/objective/store/automation modules | remove old module; salvage algorithms | Product生产进Libra，Inventory效果进Arca，Execution机制进Foundation；不保留Kairox业务Store/Gate/Run主路径 |
| `taskStore.js`、TaskAdmission、TaskScheduler、TaskControlPolicy | replace | clean Supporting Work/Attempt/Plan/Event schema；不迁移Task identity、targetGate或用户逐Task控制语义 |
| `workflowGraph.js` | salvage validator logic under new contract | DAG/type/condition算法可复用；必须支持clean nominal port、success/terminal dependency和immutable Plan |
| `workflowStore.js`、`eventRuntime.js`、`resourceRuntime.js` | rewrite on clean schema | 现有代码直接依赖Task/Kairox/config/signal；目标为Foundation Repository和typed ExecutionContext |
| `capabilityCatalog.js`、`capabilityRegistry.js`、`capabilities/*` | function-by-function audit | 只复用满足本Levelref的原子底层实现；删除allowedTargetGates、Task/Config/Store输入和complex wrapper |
| `resourceGovernor.js` | salvage bounded queue/permit algorithms | 由Foundation重新拥有并成为唯一容量Owner；删除历史Scheduler/background guard重复计数 |
| `priorityEngine.js`、media priority旧实现 | remove business model | clean Priority来自Level 6 Process；各排队点读取Projection，不建立全局Priority Engine |
| complex flow executors | delete after behavior extraction | 按`CAPABILITY_CONSERVATION.md`拆出单效果library/Capability；禁止包装后继续driveTask |
| `configStore.js` | split and replace | Domain Policy归Owner Store，platform typed settings独立；不再把整份Config注入Runtime/Executor |
| `personCatalogStore.js`、`peopleStore.js` | replace | People Management独立Repository；Media-Cast Fact留处理媒体的Domain |
| Emby/TMDB/Douban/MoviePilot/adult/Worker services | retain protocol code behind adapters | 只实现typed Integration ports；不得写Domain facts或创建Work |
| FFmpeg/FFprobe/transcode helpers | retain low-level library after safety audit | 被Libra/Arca不同Capability wrapper复用；不决定Planner路径、Owner或正式Material commit |
| `mediaLibraryService.js`、`adultLibraryService.js` | split and retire aggregate service | Field/Procurement、Libra Product、Arca Inventory、People和Projection分别拥有事实；不保留全局media item cache |
| `app.js` | Level 9 adapter rewrite | 只调用Application Facade/Projection；不再包含业务Decision、Store write或Task creation |
| current Admin Web | Level 9 product-surface rewrite | 旧Library/Maintenance/Task心智不反向决定Level 8组件 |

#### 8.8.3 Function-level conservation ledger

实施前必须基于本Level Catalog把现有每个Capability/Executor关键函数登记为：

~~~text
reuse_low_level_library
rewrite_as_clean_capability
split_across_clean_capabilities
move_to_domain_decision_or_planner
move_to_integration_adapter
remove_legacy_semantics
~~~

每项登记包含current file/function、historical behavior、clean owner、target capability/component、输入/输出、
Effect Class、安全证据、测试去向。没有登记的旧函数不能直接复制到`src/helix/`；登记为删除的语义不能以
“兼容”名义回流。

现有八个Capability注册文件中的匿名`execute`函数，以
`<file>#register[<historical-capability-ref>]`作为稳定审计identity。62个注册项与

台账结论不是“旧文件可整体搬迁”：`62/62`旧Executor均至少含旧Task/Config/Store/Gate或正式Material权限
耦合，clean实现只能复用表中明确标为pure/protocol/file-transaction library的函数，并为每个新Executor重新
完成input/output、Effect、Fence、resource和crash-window contract test。

#### 8.8.4 Clean schema不迁移旧运行时事实

Clean Runtime使用新的单库schema generation和全新表族，不读取或迁移旧`library.db`、`tasks.db`、旧
config完整快照、Membership、Admission、Gate Facts、Task/Flow/Event或People JSON。旧数据可以在Level 10
定义的备份中保留为历史文件，但不能dual-read或自动投影为clean事实。

启动时发现active data directory同时存在旧schema和clean schema，必须拒绝进入可写运行态并要求Level 10
定义的clean initialization；不能自动清空、自动迁移或“先兼容跑起来”。具体marker、工具和错误文案留
Level 10。

#### 8.8.5 Implementation slices只能沿组件边界切换

未来clean-cut实施顺序至少满足：

1. contracts、SQLite Kernel、Foundation schema与静态依赖门禁；
2. Material Control、Outbox/Inbox、Work/Plan/Event与Effect recovery；
3. User Perception和People独立Store/Facade；
4. Procurement完整Domain与Handoff A；
5. Libra完整Domain、Workspace和Handoff B package；
6. Arca Acceptance、On-deck、Inventory和Deck Fact；
7. Aftercare、Off-deck与Shelf Administration；
8. Level 9 Application Facade/API/Admin Web；
9. Level 10 clean initialization、全量验证和发布。

切片顺序不授权“新Procurement接旧Membership”“新Libra写旧media_items”或“新Event Runtime驱动旧complex
Executor”等混合主路径。测试夹具可以isolated验证未接线模块，但可运行产品只能在完整clean root切换后
启动。

### 8.9 Level 0–7一致性与完整性审计

#### 8.9.1 Upstream consistency matrix

| `8.0` | Level 0产品本体、Level 2五Domain、Level 7非第六Domain | preserved |
| `8.1` | 模块化单体、唯一Composition Root、内部Facade边界 | preserved |
| `8.2` | Level 2–3 Canonical Owner/Object/Process | preserved |
| `8.3` | Level 6 Supporting Work/Automation、Level 7五层Foundation | preserved |
| `8.4` | Level 4两次单向Handoff、Query/Signal非责任转移 | preserved |
| `8.5` | Identity/Binding/Control分离、Accepted/On-deck/Off-deck atomicity | preserved |
| `8.6` | Level 5 Outcome-only Policy、Level 7 atomic Capability与能力守恒 | preserved |
| `8.7` | Canonical Owner唯一写入、GET无副作用、Runtime不拥有业务 | preserved |

当前结构没有引入新的Business Domain、Owner、Handoff、Policy、Authorization或用户旅程。

#### 8.9.2 Component coverage audit

Level 6–7要求的Process/technical responsibility均有唯一物理承载：

- Field Management、Triage、Candidate publication与Handoff A已落到Procurement/Libra Intake；
- Decision Preparation、Routing、Spec、Production、Package与Workspace Reclamation已落到Libra；
- Shelf Administration、Acceptance、fixed Off-load、Inventory、Aftercare与Off-deck已落到Arca；
- Perception Resolution与Person Registry分别拥有独立Facade/Store；
- Work、Plan、Event、Capability、Resource、Control、Effect和Diagnostics已落到Foundation；
- Projection和Integration明确为技术边界，不成为Fact Owner。

不存在只能通过旧Membership、Nexora、Kairox Gate、Task chain或complex Executor才能完成的Process责任。

#### 8.9.3 Atomicity closure audit

选择一个物理SQLite数据库解决了Level 7保留的关键工程闭环：

- Responsibility Transfer Point可以与接收方责任Fact、Binding和Control transfer原子成立；
- 上游关闭交付责任使用Receipt异步幂等，不要求跨Domain Repository写入；
- Libra Deliverable promotion可以与Product Package publication及新Material Control acquire原子成立；
- Libra Run discard可以与原始Input Control release和Cleanup Scope原子成立，受Control Workspace Product则在
  删除Evidence后由独立Cleanup Commit释放Control；
- On-deck、Aftercare Inventory、Off-deck和Deregistration域内commit可以与Control变化原子成立；
- 文件和Provider副作用仍通过Effect Receipt/Reconcile处理，没有伪造跨系统事务。

该选择只改变物理原子性机制，不合并Domain Store或Canonical Owner。

机械审计结果：

duplicate refs                    0

envelope和Result type family。`deferred`不再冒充Result，`OnDeckCommitResult`明确要求同一事务产生Receipt与
Offload Completion Fact。Catalog中新增的Aftercare Inventory commit只填补Accepted“安全提交新Inventory
revision”的技术原子性，不新增用户旅程；Aftercare Settlement Approval由现有Service Catalogue、Shelf
Standard与Care Basis派生，不创建新的用户Authorization。
97的当前值包含`PBF-11-R2-R1`对Handoff A/Handoff B拒绝Receipt的nominal分型；`PBF-12/PBF-13`新增的

`PBF-14`的三个Product Fact variants属于既有Domain Fact Commit内部closed variants，不重复计数。

#### 8.9.5 Persistence closure audit

逐表合同共有`178 tables / 178 unique names / 0 invalid prefix / 0 duplicate definition`：

~~~text
fx_          25
proc_        16
libra_       45
arca_        54
perception_   9
people_      13
platform_    16
~~~

每个表已经给出PK/core columns、决定正确性的unique/partial unique约束和热查询索引；统一规则固定revision、
digest、FK、append-only、JSON byte limit与current pointer。审计中特别关闭了以下容易重新制造架构漏洞的点：

- Physical Material Control具有current row和append-only revision history；Procurement的control projection不
  替代最终CAS；
- Candidate、Episode Delivery、Product、Off-load Context和Inventory成员关系化，不保存巨型Manifest JSON；
- Product Metadata/Media-Cast Fact以Libra relation显式引用其精确closed Source Basis Result（Metadata Observation或
  Western Analysis/Normalize/Match），Fact history不扫描later current Result，也不把Foundation Event Result当成
  无归属缓存；
- Libra Package publication先为新Deliverable Identity取得Control，不存在“Package已发布但Material无Owner”；
- Arca保存Accepted Product Fact/Person Relation snapshot，Aftercare不运行时回读Libra Store；
- Canonical Content Identity不做全局unique，允许Duplicate Detection；同一Shelf内Season identity使用partial
  unique确保后续Episode Run扩充同一Shelf Entry；
- Event resource timing、Effect Journal、Outbox/Inbox、Artifact reference和Workspace reference均有durable
  Evidence，Permit本身仍不持久化；
- Event current progress、Routing/Template/Off-deck/Resource current head、Care Basis、standing Authorization、
  People Candidate和Off-deck pre-authorization Review/Reservation/Scope均有显式关系事实；
- Perception Acquisition、跨Acquisition cursor head、page CAS、Record/Anchor/Record Relation、typed page receipt与
  commit result形成显式闭合链；Normalize不依赖Provider二次读取，pure Acquire不写Artifact，Canonical rating
  只允许1–5或null，Commit/Result digest均有无自引用的唯一basis；
- `read_*`继续可重建且无人引用，Level 9只定义具体页面Projection字段，不改变Canonical schema。

#### 8.9.6 Function-level conservation closure audit

当前八个Capability文件的62个匿名execute registration全部以`file#register[capability]`定位，并与Level 7
Conservation Audit逐项绑定。Named helper、直接依赖和hidden post-effect也已审计：

- 允许复用的只有bounded pure algorithm、Provider protocol、FFmpeg/file-transaction底层library；
- `task/config/admission/objective/gate`上下文拼装、跨Domain Store写入、source mutation signal和output-type
  post-effect全部禁止复制；
- `mediaReplacementService`/Season replacement只可提取文件事务算法进入Arca，不得作为Libra Capability；
- 当前`62/62`旧Executor均需要重签或拆分，`0`个旧Executor可以整体搬迁；
- 已删除语义包括Gate publication、identity mismatch approval、tonemap/preview逐手段陪诊、replace/discard动作
  树、workflow.blocked伪Capability和complex Executor drive loop。

因此没有证据表明原有有效Movie、Season、JAV、Western Adult、Metadata、Transcode、Remux、MoviePilot、
Worker、People reference或文件安全能力被静默遗漏；“底层算法可复用”也没有被误写成“旧Owner可继承”。

#### 8.9.7 Transaction and crash-window contract fixtures

Level 8固定后续实现必须建立的可执行contract fixture，不把“以后补测试”当设计缺口：

| Fixture | Fault injection points | Required invariant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Handoff A Accepted | Candidate Delivery snapshot重建前后、global continuity head CAS前后、continuity match前后、并发Subject/episode/Resolved Identity exact anchor变化、target Intake CAS前后、Decision/Subject/Binding N:M relation participant后、逐项Control CAS/transfer revision及Control set digest组装前后、Result/marker/Outbox前、Control后来再次转移后历史重放 | Snapshot的Offer/Package/Manifest/Location Evidence不一致即fail closed且不旁读`proc_*`修补；exact claim唯一命中且zero overlap才extension；0/N命中、缺失或overlap新建Subject；global head阻止query phantom，target head阻止唯一Subject stale extension；竞态使Decision失效后重新装配；new Subject identity pointer为NULL；Handle/Payload/Control scope、expected与committed projection、from/to scope、marker/basis必须逐项闭合，Control set按唯一formula生成；要么全部不存在，要么global/target revision、Decision及match/overlap Evidence、Subject/claim/Episode scope、每Material Binding及全部Episode relation、Control revision、Receipt/Result/marker/Outbox全部成立；后续current owner变化仍能从historical revision重建同一Receipt；Procurement只异步消费Receipt |
| Procurement Handoff A acceptance consume | Inbox写入前后、open Delivery CAS前后、1/1024个Reservation逐项转移中途、Delivery terminal与Inbox result提交前后、迟到Rejected消息 | Delivery、全部Candidate member `transferred+handoff_accepted`、同一Receipt Evidence与Inbox result全有或全无；Material Control完全不改写；相同Accepted message重放同一closure digest，已rejected/成员不完整/digest冲突稳定拒绝；Repository只允许声明的`open → accepted`和`candidate_delivery → transferred`CAS，terminal row不得再UPDATE |
| Handoff A Rejected | Candidate/Material/Control Verification形成前后、Reason/Evidence rows逐项写入中途、Decision/Receipt/Result/marker/Outbox各边界、相同Offer的Accepted竞态 | 只允许closed Handoff A reason；Continuity 0/N/overlap不得误判rejected；要么Decision/全部Reason Evidence/Receipt/Result/marker/Rejected Outbox全部不存在，要么全部成立且typed digest可由Owner rows重建；任何分支均不读写continuity head、不创建Subject/Binding、不转移Control；相同Offer只能有一个terminal Decision，相同marker重放原Receipt/Message |
| Procurement Handoff A rejection consume | Inbox写入前后、open Delivery CAS前后、1/1024个Reservation逐项释放中途、Delivery terminal与Inbox result提交前后、迟到Accepted消息 | Delivery、全部Candidate member `released+handoff_rejected`、同一Receipt Evidence与Inbox result全有或全无；Procurement Material Control完全不变；相同Rejected message重放同一closure digest，已accepted/成员不完整/digest冲突稳定拒绝；Repository只允许声明的`open → rejected`和`candidate_delivery → released`CAS，terminal row不得再UPDATE，绝不部分释放或重开Run |
| Material Identity | mount remap/container restart、inode reuse、采样中stat变化、Fingerprint中断与Control acquire前 | 稳定Mount Scope才继承Identity；完成中段最多256 KiB Fingerprint前无Control；采样前后stat fence必须一致；同Fingerprint不同inode仍是不同Identity；任何路径均不得退化为全文件读取 |
| Material Field Profile Hint | create省略/显式mixed/五项enum、Field aggregate与revision 1插入中间、URL/body mismatch、expected revision CAS、same value no-op、same-key replay/conflict、current pointer切换前后崩溃、active Observation/Run存在时修订 | 缺省只规范化为显式mixed且digest唯一；Field/current pointer/Profile revision及Foundation receipt/marker/audit全有或全无；same value不加revision；旧revision immutable且可历史恢复；current修改不改写旧Observation/Run/Retry/Candidate，也不通过Session/caller/current cache注入Triage |
| Field Observation Page | Page DTO/Access/Profile Hint/Request digest验证前后、64 MiB physical-read边界、Field Observation/Profile heads CAS前后、immutable page header与`proc_field_observation_entries` rows写入前后、compact typed Result/marker前后、零Outbox协调、响应前崩溃 | 任一DTO、顺序、continuity、digest、Supporting Work或CAS验证失败整页rollback；entry rows、Page header、Field head、Hint Snapshot revision、current Material physical projection、typed Result和marker全有或全无；Page Result不含文件明细；同一Work每页Snapshot相同，Hint切换后旧Work后续页零写入；同marker重放返回原Result且不推进revision；历史Observation由entry rows重建 |

#### 8.9.8 Boundary and dependency closure audit

以Level 0–7 Owner和本Level dependency matrix反向审计后：

- 五个Domain均有自己的Object/Process/Repository/public Facade；不存在第六业务域或共享业务Store；
- Foundation只有技术事实，CommitParticipant持有Owner SQL但不向Executor/Planner暴露Repository；
- Handoff仍只有A/B两次单向责任转移；Query、Signal、Receipt和Off-load Completion均未被误写成Handoff；
- Kairox只保留为Libra Production内部专业组织，Nexora无clean物理组件或Owner；
- Arca fixed Off-load、Aftercare与Off-deck使用不同Process Basis和destructive合同，只有底层Inventory/文件算法
  可按明确ref复用；
- 一个SQLite只用于原子提交，不授权跨Domain import、join或Repository访问；
- 没有重新引入全局MediaItem、Membership、SourceBinding、Admission、Gate、Task chain、flowKind路由或全局
  Automation/Priority Engine。

#### 8.9.9 Level 8 closure result

本轮封闭审计结论为：

~~~text
ENGINEERING CONTRACT COMPLETE / JOURNEY AMENDMENT APPLIED
UPSTREAM CONSISTENCY PASS
CAPABILITY CONSERVATION PASS
PERSISTENCE / ATOMICITY PASS
NO OPEN BUSINESS DECISION
USER-ACCEPTED BASELINE PRESERVED
~~~

2026-07-16 Level 9 Journey Reverse Audit发现的物理闭合缺口已经按Accepted业务语义作bounded amendment：
补齐Discard/Cleanup、Placement Care Basis、Routing/Template head、Progress、standing Authorization、Platform、
People Candidate与Off-deck Review链路；没有改变Level 8既有用户接受的Domain/Handoff/Authorization。

实际JSON Schema文件、DDL/migration、module代码、contract fixture和静态依赖测试属于Implementation阶段的
交付物；它们的字段/约束和失败标准已经在本Level确定，不再是开放设计问题。实施中若发现必须改变用户
旅程、Owner、Handoff、Authorization或Accepted Business Object，必须回到对应上游Level，不能修改Level 8
实现细节绕过。
